## 7.6 Annotate Spatial Domains Based on Cell Type Enrichment

Based on the cell type enrichment patterns, we can annotate domains with biologically meaningful names.

``` {r annotate_spatial_domains}
message("\nAnnotating spatial domains based on enrichment patterns...")

# Get enrichment data for annotation
domain_enrichment <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(region, cellType) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  mutate(
    proportion = n_cells / sum(n_cells),
    total_cells = sum(n_cells)
  ) %>%
  arrange(region, desc(proportion))

# Display top 3 cell types per region to guide annotation
message("\nTop 3 cell types per spatial domain:")
for (r in sort(unique(domain_enrichment$region))) {
  top3 <- domain_enrichment %>%
    filter(region == r) %>%
    head(3)

  message("\n", r, " (N=", top3$total_cells[1], " cells):")
  for (i in 1:nrow(top3)) {
    message(
      "  ", i, ". ", top3$cellType[i], ": ",
      round(top3$proportion[i] * 100, 1), "%"
    )
  }
}

# REVIEW REQUIRED: Domain compositions below were based on post-hoc gated
# cell types (including Tfh/Tfr). With APPLY_POST_HOC_GATING = FALSE,
# re-examine region bubble plots and update annotations accordingly.
# Annotations reflect the dominant cell populations in each spatial region
domain_annotations <- data.frame(
  region = paste0("region_", 1:k_regions),
  annotation = c(
    "Th2_T_Cell_Zone",       # region_1 (3K): Th2 (98%), Resting (1%)
    "T_Cell_Zone",           # region_2 (59K): CD8+ (53%), Resting (15%), Tg Tregs (8%)
    "Treg_Zone",             # region_3 (176K): Tg Tregs (24%), Resting (16%), Treg-APC (16%)
    "Low_Intensity_Zone",    # region_4 (50K): Indeterminate (61%), Resting (12%), Endo Tregs (6%)
    "Th2_T_Cell_Zone",       # region_5 (38K): Th2 (95%), Resting (4%)
    "Resting_Lymphoid_Zone", # region_6 (149K): Resting (65%), Act B (8%), Tg Tregs (5%)
    "Th2_T_Cell_Zone",       # region_7 (15K): Th2 (98%), Resting (2%)
    "B_Cell_Zone"            # region_8 (120K): B (38%), Act B (32%), IL10+ CD4+ (12%)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

message("\n📝 Domain Annotations (adjust based on enrichment patterns):")
print(domain_annotations)

# Export annotation guide
annotation_file <- file.path(domains_dir, "spatial_domain_annotations.csv")
write.csv(domain_annotations, annotation_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("\n✓ Annotation guide saved to: ", basename(annotation_file))

message("\n💡 IMPORTANT: Update the 'annotation' column in the CSV file based on")
message("   the cell type enrichment patterns you observed above.")

# Assign annotations to single cells
# We use match() since colData is a DataFrame, not a standard data.frame for left_join
# Ensure region is character for matching
combined_spe$region <- as.character(combined_spe$region)
combined_spe$annotation <- domain_annotations$annotation[match(combined_spe$region, domain_annotations$region)]

# Verify assignment
message("\nDomain assignment summary:")
print(table(combined_spe$annotation))

# Create color mapping for annotations
annot_cols <- c(
  "B_Cell_Zone"           = "#4A90B8",  # muted steel blue
  "Treg_Zone"             = "#8B008B",  # dark magenta — Treg-dominated
  "T_Cell_Zone"           = "#D2691E",  # burnt orange — Tfh-dominated
  "Th2_T_Cell_Zone"       = "#2E8B57",  # sea green
  "Resting_Lymphoid_Zone" = "#D9D9D9",  # light grey — neutral
  "Low_Intensity_Zone"    = "#BDBDBD"   # medium grey — neutral
)

message("\nColor mapping established:")

# --- REGENERATE PLOTS WITH ANNOTATIONS ---

# 1. Annotated Hatching Plot
# Generate for all images at once to avoid subsetting issues and ensure consistent patterns

all_images <- levels(combined_spe$imageID)

## 7.6.1 Compare Spatial Domains Between Images

With 2 images, we can compare how spatial domains differ between samples, focusing on differences that may relate to treatment or condition.

``` {r compare_domains_between_images, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
message("Comparing spatial domain composition between images...")

# Get region-cellType composition for each image
domain_composition <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(imageID, region, cellType) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(imageID, region) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_region = sum(n_cells),
    proportion = n_cells / total_in_region
  )

# Export full composition
comp_export <- file.path(domains_dir, "spatial_domain_composition_full.csv")
write.csv(domain_composition, comp_export, row.names = FALSE)
message("✓ Full domain composition saved to: ", basename(comp_export))

# Calculate domain size differences between images
domain_sizes <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(imageID, region) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(imageID) %>%
  mutate(
    total_cells = sum(n_cells),
    proportion = n_cells / total_cells
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Pivot to compare between images
domain_size_comparison <- domain_sizes %>%
  select(imageID, region, proportion) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = imageID, values_from = proportion, values_fill = 0) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = abs(.[[3]] - .[[2]]), # Absolute difference
    fold_change = .[[3]] / (.[[2]] + 1e-10) # Avoid division by zero
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(difference))

message("\nTop 5 most different spatial domains (by size):")
print(head(domain_size_comparison, 5))

# Export domain size comparison
size_comp_file <- file.path(domains_dir, "spatial_domain_size_comparison.csv")
write.csv(domain_size_comparison, size_comp_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("✓ Domain size comparison saved to: ", basename(size_comp_file))

# For each region, compare composition between images
message("\nRegion composition comparison:")
for (r in sort(unique(domain_composition$region))) {
  # Get the annotated name for this region
  r_annotation <- domain_annotations$annotation[domain_annotations$region == r]
  message("\n", r, " (", r_annotation, "):")

  region_data <- domain_composition %>%
    filter(region == r) %>%
    select(imageID, cellType, n_cells, proportion) %>%
    arrange(imageID, desc(proportion))

  for (img in unique(region_data$imageID)) {
    img_data <- region_data %>% filter(imageID == img)
    message(
      "  ", img, ": ", nrow(img_data), " cell types, ",
      sum(img_data$n_cells), " total cells"
    )

    # Show top 3 cell types
    top3 <- head(img_data, 3)
    for (i in 1:nrow(top3)) {
      message(
        "    • ", top3$cellType[i], ": ",
        round(top3$proportion[i] * 100, 1), "%"
      )
    }
  }
  # Investigate Region 2 Discrepancy (User Request)
  message("\n🔍 Detailed investigation of Region 2 (T_Cell_Zone):")
  r2_data <- domain_composition %>%
    filter(region == "region_2")

  for (img in unique(r2_data$imageID)) {
    img_subset <- r2_data %>%
      filter(imageID == img) %>%
      arrange(desc(proportion))
    message("\n  Image: ", img)
    message("  Total cells in Region 2: ", sum(img_subset$n_cells))

    if (nrow(img_subset) > 0) {
      print(head(img_subset[, c("cellType", "n_cells", "proportion")], 5))
    } else {
      message("  (No cells found in Region 2 for this image)")
    }
  }
}

# Identify regions with largest compositional differences
comp_diff <- domain_composition %>%
  select(imageID, region, cellType, proportion) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = imageID, values_from = proportion, values_fill = 0) %>%
  ungroup() %>% # Remove any grouping before mutate
  mutate(
    diff = abs(.[[4]] - .[[3]]) # Absolute difference in proportion
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(diff))

# Export compositional differences

print(comp_plot)

# Save
comp_file <- file.path(domains_dir, "spatial_domains_composition_comparison.png")
ggsave(
  filename = comp_file,

  bg = "white"
)

message("\n✓ Composition comparison plot saved to: ", basename(comp_file))
```

### 7.6.1b Focused Composition of Key Domains

Targeted composition plots for the three domains of primary interest (B Cell Zone, Treg Zone, T Cell Zone), comparing CAR vs EGFR conditions. Three views: B-cell focused, T-cell focused, and overall.

```{r focused_domain_composition, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
# --- Filter to domains of interest ---
target_domains <- c("B_Cell_Zone", "Treg_Zone", "T_Cell_Zone")
domain_labels <- c(
  "B_Cell_Zone" = "B Cell Zone",
  "Treg_Zone"   = "Treg Zone",
  "T_Cell_Zone" = "T Cell Zone"
)

comp_focused <- domain_composition_annotated %>%
  filter(annotation %in% target_domains) %>%
  mutate(
    domain = factor(domain_labels[annotation], levels = rev(domain_labels)),
    condition = ifelse(grepl("CAR", imageID), "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg")
  )

# =========================================================================
# Plot 1: B Cell Focus (B Cells, Activated B Cells, Other)
# =========================================================================
message("\n[1/3] B-cell focused composition...")

b_cell_types <- c("B Cells", "Activated B Cells")
b_cell_cols <- c(
  "Activated B Cells" = "#4169E1",
  "B Cells" = "#00008B",
  "Other" = "grey70"
)

comp_bcell <- comp_focused %>%
  filter(cellType %in% b_cell_types) %>%
  group_by(domain, condition, cellType) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(domain, condition) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_group = proportion / sum(proportion)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cellType = factor(
      cellType,
      levels = c("B Cells", "Activated B Cells")
    ),
    pct_label = scales::percent(pct_of_group, accuracy = 0.1)
  )

p_bcell <- ggplot(
  comp_bcell,
  aes(x = condition, y = pct_of_group, fill = cellType)
) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = pct_label, color = cellType),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 1.2, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ domain, ncol = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = b_cell_cols, name = NULL) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "B Cells" = "white",
    "Activated B Cells" = "black"
  )) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "B Cell Composition",
    subtitle = "% of total B cells",
    x = NULL, y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.15, "cm")
  )

print(p_bcell)
ggsave(
  file.path(domains_dir, "Focused_Composition_BCells.png"),
  p_bcell, width = 3, height = 3, bg = "white"
)
message("  \u2713 Saved Focused_Composition_BCells.png")

# =========================================================================
# Plot 2: T Cell Focus (T cell variants + Other)
# =========================================================================
message("\n[2/3] T-cell focused composition...")

t_cell_types <- c(
  "Transgenic Tregs", "Endogenous Tregs",
  "Treg-APC Conjugates",
  "Th2 T Cells", "Activated CD8+ T Cells",
  "Indeterminate Cells",
  "Exhausted T Cells",
  "IL10+ CD4+ T Cells"

t_cell_cols <- celltype_colors[

comp_tcell <- comp_focused %>%

  group_by(domain, condition, cellType) %>%
  summarise(proportion = sum(proportion), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(domain, condition) %>%
  mutate(pct_of_group = proportion / sum(proportion)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    cellType = factor(cellType, levels = rev(t_cell_types)),
    pct_label = ifelse(

p_tcell <- ggplot(

# =========================================================================

comp_overall <- comp_focused %>%

## 7.6.2 Target Population Distribution Across Spatial Domains

**Configurable: identify a target cell population by marker threshold OR annotation, then compare its distribution across spatial domains between images.**

``` {r target_population_spatial_domains, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION — Define the target population
# ============================================================================
# Mode: "marker" or "annotation"
target_pop_mode <- "annotation"

# --- marker mode settings ---
# Identify cells positive for a specific marker above a threshold
target_marker_pattern <- "CXCR5"         # regex to match marker in rownames
target_marker_threshold <- NULL          # NULL = use 98th percentile (data-driven)
target_marker_label <- "CXCR5+"          # label for plots/filenames

# --- annotation mode settings ---
# Identify cells matching specific cellType annotation(s)
target_annotations <- c("Indeterminate Cells")
target_annotation_label <- "Indeterminate"  # label for plots/filenames

# ============================================================================
message("\n=== Section 7.6.2: Target Population Distribution by Spatial Domain ===")

all_marks <- rownames(combined_spe)

if (target_pop_mode == "marker") {

  # Find the marker
  marker_match <- grep(target_marker_pattern, all_marks, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(marker_match) == 0) {
    stop("No marker matching '", target_marker_pattern, "' found. Available: ",
         paste(head(all_marks, 10), collapse = ", "), "...")
  }
  target_marker_name <- marker_match[1]
  message("Mode: marker | Using: ", target_marker_name)

  # Extract expression
  marker_expr <- assay(combined_spe[target_marker_name, ], "norm")[1, ]

  # Determine threshold
  if (is.null(target_marker_threshold)) {
    target_marker_threshold <- quantile(marker_expr, 0.98, na.rm = TRUE)
    message("Threshold (98th percentile): ", round(target_marker_threshold, 4))
  } else {
    message("Threshold (user-defined): ", target_marker_threshold)
  }

  is_target_positive <- marker_expr > target_marker_threshold
  pop_label <- target_marker_label
  file_prefix <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", target_marker_label))

} else if (target_pop_mode == "annotation") {

  message("Mode: annotation | Matching: ", paste(target_annotations, collapse = ", "))
  is_target_positive <- combined_spe$cellType %in% target_annotations
  pop_label <- target_annotation_label
  file_prefix <- tolower(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", target_annotation_label))

} else {
  stop("Invalid target_pop_mode: '", target_pop_mode, "'. Use 'marker' or 'annotation'.")
}

# Create output subdirectory: domains_dir/Target_Population/<label>/
pop_output_dir <- file.path(domains_dir, "Target_Population", file_prefix)
dir.create(pop_output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
message("Output directory: ", pop_output_dir)

message("Target cells: ", sum(is_target_positive), " / ", length(is_target_positive),
        " (", round(100 * mean(is_target_positive), 2), "%)")

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE PER-DOMAIN STATISTICS
# ============================================================================
domain_stats <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(is_target = is_target_positive) %>%
  group_by(imageID, region) %>%
  summarise(
    n_cells = n(),
    n_target = sum(is_target),
    pct_target = 100 * n_target / n_cells,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(domain_annotations, by = "region") %>%
  mutate(domain_label = paste0(annotation, "\n(", region, ")")) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_target))

message("\n", pop_label, " enrichment by spatial domain:")
print(domain_stats %>% select(imageID, region, annotation, n_cells, n_target, pct_target))

# Export
stats_file <- file.path(pop_output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "_by_spatial_domain.csv"))
write.csv(domain_stats, stats_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("✓ Saved: ", basename(stats_file))

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 1: PERCENTAGE BAR CHART (dodged by image)
# ============================================================================
p_pct <- ggplot(domain_stats, aes(x = domain_label, y = pct_target, fill = imageID)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = paste0(round(pct_target, 1), "%")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3, size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(pop_label, "Proportion by Spatial Domain"),
    subtitle = paste("% of cells in each domain that are", pop_label),
    x = "Spatial Domain", y = paste(pop_label, "(%)"), fill = "Image"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_pct)
ggsave(
  file.path(pop_output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "_by_domain_percentage.png")),
  p_pct, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 2: ABSOLUTE FREQUENCY BAR CHART (dodged by image)
# ============================================================================
p_freq <- ggplot(domain_stats, aes(x = domain_label, y = n_target, fill = imageID)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.7), width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = format(n_target, big.mark = ",")),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
    vjust = -0.3, size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(pop_label, "Frequency by Spatial Domain"),
    subtitle = paste("Absolute count of", pop_label, "cells per domain"),
    x = "Spatial Domain", y = paste(pop_label, "Cell Count"), fill = "Image"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    legend.position = "top"
  )

print(p_freq)
ggsave(
  file.path(pop_output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "_by_domain_frequency.png")),
  p_freq, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)

# ============================================================================
# INTER-IMAGE COMPARISON
# ============================================================================
if (length(unique(domain_stats$imageID)) > 1) {
  domain_comparison <- domain_stats %>%
    select(imageID, region, annotation, pct_target) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = imageID, values_from = pct_target, values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(difference = abs(.[[4]] - .[[3]])) %>%
    arrange(desc(difference))

  message("\nDomains with largest ", pop_label, " % differences between images:")
  print(domain_comparison)

  comp_file <- file.path(pop_output_dir, paste0(file_prefix, "_domain_comparison.csv"))
  write.csv(domain_comparison, comp_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message("✓ Saved: ", basename(comp_file))
}

message("\n=== Section 7.6.2 Complete ===")
```

## 7.6.3 Domain-Specific Cell Population Analysis

**Configurable analysis of cell populations within a target spatial domain.**
Set `domain_cell_analysis` to `"B_Cell_Zone"`, `"Treg_Zone"`, or `"T_Cell_Zone"` to switch modes.

``` {r domain_cell_population_analysis, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
# ============================================================================
# CONFIGURATION — Set the analysis mode
# ============================================================================
domain_cell_analysis <- "B_Cell_Zone" # "B_Cell_Zone", "Treg_Zone", or "T_Cell_Zone"

message("\n=== Section 7.6.3: ", domain_cell_analysis, " Cell Population Analysis ===")

# Helper to find marker names from rownames
all_marks <- rownames(combined_spe)
find_marker <- function(pattern, marks) {
  matches <- grep(pattern, marks, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(matches) > 0) return(matches[1]) else return(NA)
}

# Ensure condition column exists
if (!"condition" %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe))) {
  combined_spe$condition <- factor(ifelse(
    grepl("CAR", combined_spe$imageID), "CAR", "EGFR"
  ))
}

# ============================================================================
# MODE-SPECIFIC CONFIGURATION
# ============================================================================
if (domain_cell_analysis == "B_Cell_Zone") {

  target_domain       <- "B_Cell_Zone"
  analysis_label      <- "B Cell Zone"

  # Annotation-based: B lineage + Treg-APC co-residents
  cell_types_of_interest <- c(
    "B Cells", "Activated B Cells", "Treg-APC Conjugates"
  )
  interest_colors <- c(
    "B Cells"                    = "#00008B", # darkblue
    "Activated B Cells"          = "#4169E1", # royalblue
    "Treg-APC Conjugates"        = "#BA55D3", # mediumorchid
    "Other"                      = "grey80"
  )

  # Markers to evaluate across all cells in domain
  eval_markers <- c(
    CD40  = find_marker("CD40", all_marks),
    MHCII = find_marker("IA-IE", all_marks),
    PDL1  = find_marker("PDL1|CD274", all_marks),
    CXCR5 = find_marker("CXCR5", all_marks),
    PD1   = find_marker("PD1", all_marks),
    CD19  = find_marker("CD19-FITC", all_marks)
  )

  # Marker-threshold profile: identify Activated B Cells by gating (CD19+, CD40+)
  # Thresholds from section 4.6.1 post-hoc gating (single source of truth)
  # Only available when APPLY_POST_HOC_GATING = TRUE
  if (exists("gate_thresholds")) {
  threshold_profile_name  <- "Activated B Cells (Threshold)"
  threshold_negative_name <- "Other B Cells (Threshold)"
  threshold_gates <- list(
    list(marker = find_marker("CD19-FITC", all_marks), threshold = gate_thresholds$CD19, direction = "above"),
    list(marker = find_marker("CD40", all_marks),      threshold = gate_thresholds$CD40, direction = "above")
  )
  threshold_colors <- c(
    "Activated B Cells (Threshold)" = "#4169E1",
    "Other B Cells (Threshold)"     = "#00008B",
    "Non-target"                    = "grey80"
  )
  } # end gate_thresholds guard (B_Cell_Zone)

} else if (domain_cell_analysis == "Treg_Zone") {

  target_domain       <- "Treg_Zone"
  analysis_label      <- "Treg Zone"

  # Annotation-based: Treg populations, B cells, and co-resident cells
  cell_types_of_interest <- c(
    "Transgenic Tregs", "Endogenous Tregs",
    "B Cells", "Activated B Cells",
    "Treg-APC Conjugates"
  )
  interest_colors <- c(
    "Transgenic Tregs"                       = "#8B008B",
    "Endogenous Tregs"                       = "#9370DB",
    "B Cells"                                = "#00008B",
    "Activated B Cells"                      = "#4169E1",
    "Treg-APC Conjugates"                    = "#BA55D3",
    "Other"                                  = "grey80"
  )

  # Markers to evaluate across all cells in domain
  eval_markers <- c(
    CD4   = find_marker("CD4", all_marks),
    Foxp3 = find_marker("Foxp3", all_marks),
    GFP   = find_marker("GFP", all_marks),
    CTLA4 = find_marker("CTLA-4", all_marks),
    CD40  = find_marker("CD40", all_marks),
    CD19  = find_marker("CD19-FITC", all_marks),
    PD1   = find_marker("PD1", all_marks)
  )

  # Marker-threshold profile: identify Tregs (CD4+, GFP+)
  if (exists("gate_thresholds")) {
  threshold_profile_name  <- "Tregs (Threshold)"
  threshold_negative_name <- "Other Cells (Threshold)"
  threshold_gates <- list(
    list(marker = find_marker("CD4", all_marks),   threshold = gate_thresholds$CD4, direction = "above"),
    list(marker = find_marker("GFP", all_marks),   threshold = gate_thresholds$GFP, direction = "above")
  )
  threshold_colors <- c(
    "Tregs (Threshold)"      = "#8B008B",
    "Other Cells (Threshold)" = "#FFD700",
    "Non-target"             = "grey80"
  )
  } # end gate_thresholds guard (Treg_Zone)

} else if (domain_cell_analysis == "T_Cell_Zone") {

  target_domain       <- "T_Cell_Zone"
  analysis_label      <- "T Cell Zone"

  # Annotation-based: T cell zone populations
  cell_types_of_interest <- c(
    "Transgenic Tregs", "Endogenous Tregs",
    "Indeterminate Cells",
    "Exhausted T Cells",
    "Activated CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  interest_colors <- c(
    "Transgenic Tregs"                       = "#8B008B",
    "Endogenous Tregs"                       = "#9370DB",
    "Indeterminate Cells"               = "grey60",
    "Exhausted T Cells"                      = "#CD3700",
    "Activated CD8+ T Cells"                 = "#FF4500",
    "Other"                                  = "grey80"
  )

  # Markers to evaluate across all cells in domain
  eval_markers <- c(
    CD4   = find_marker("CD4", all_marks),
    CXCR5 = find_marker("CXCR5", all_marks),
    PD1   = find_marker("PD1", all_marks),
    Foxp3 = find_marker("Foxp3", all_marks),
    GFP   = find_marker("GFP", all_marks),
    CTLA4 = find_marker("CTLA-4", all_marks)
  )

  # Marker-threshold profile: identify Tfh (CD4+, CXCR5+)
  if (exists("gate_thresholds")) {
  threshold_profile_name  <- "Tfh (Threshold)"
  threshold_negative_name <- "Other Cells (Threshold)"
  threshold_gates <- list(
    list(marker = find_marker("CD4", all_marks),   threshold = gate_thresholds$CD4, direction = "above"),
    list(marker = find_marker("CXCR5", all_marks), threshold = gate_thresholds$CXCR5, direction = "above")
  )
  threshold_colors <- c(
    "Tfh (Threshold)"        = "#FFD700",
    "Other Cells (Threshold)" = "#9370DB",
    "Non-target"             = "grey80"
  )
  } # end gate_thresholds guard (T_Cell_Zone)

} else {
  stop("Invalid domain_cell_analysis: '", domain_cell_analysis,
       "'. Use 'B_Cell_Zone', 'Treg_Zone', or 'T_Cell_Zone'.")
}

# Remove NA markers
eval_markers <- eval_markers[!is.na(eval_markers)]

# Create output subdirectory
analysis_dir <- file.path(domains_dir, domain_cell_analysis)
dir.create(analysis_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
message("Output directory: ", analysis_dir)

# ============================================================================
# FILTER TO TARGET DOMAIN
# ============================================================================
is_target_domain <- combined_spe$annotation == target_domain

if (sum(is_target_domain) == 0) {
  stop("No cells found in domain '", target_domain, "'. ",
       "Available: ", paste(unique(combined_spe$annotation), collapse = ", "))
}

domain_spe <- combined_spe[, is_target_domain]
message("Cells in ", target_domain, ": ", ncol(domain_spe))

# ============================================================================
# PART 1: ANNOTATION-BASED PROPORTIONS
# ============================================================================
message("\n--- Part 1: Annotation-Based Cell Type Proportions ---")

domain_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(domain_spe)) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_group = ifelse(cellType %in% cell_types_of_interest, cellType, "Other")
  )

annotation_breakdown <- domain_meta %>%
  group_by(imageID, condition, cell_group) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(imageID, condition) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_domain = sum(n_cells),
    proportion = n_cells / total_in_domain
  )

print(annotation_breakdown)
write.csv(
  annotation_breakdown,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "annotation_based_proportions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_annotation <- ggplot(annotation_breakdown, aes(x = imageID, y = proportion, fill = cell_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(~condition, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(proportion > 0.01,
      scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = interest_colors) +
  labs(
    title = paste(analysis_label, "— Cell Type Proportions (Annotations)"),
    x = "Image", y = "Proportion", fill = "Cell Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "annotation_proportions.png"),
  p_annotation, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white"
)
message("✓ Annotation-based proportions saved")

# ============================================================================
# PART 2: MARKER EXPRESSION OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================
message("\n--- Part 2: Marker Expression in ", target_domain, " ---")

# Extract expression for cells of interest (annotation-based)
is_interest <- domain_meta$cellType %in% cell_types_of_interest
interest_spe <- domain_spe[eval_markers, is_interest]

expr_mat <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(assay(interest_spe, "norm"))))
meta_df <- colData(interest_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  select(cell_id, imageID, condition, cellType)

plot_data <- cbind(meta_df, expr_mat) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(unname(eval_markers)),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "expression"
  )

# --- Mean expression heatmap (compact, square tiles) ---
mean_expr <- plot_data %>%
  group_by(condition, marker) %>%
  summarise(mean_expression = mean(expression, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(mean_expr, file.path(analysis_dir, "marker_mean_expression.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

n_markers <- length(eval_markers)
p_heatmap <- ggplot(mean_expr, aes(x = condition, y = marker, fill = mean_expression)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(mean_expression, 2)), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red") +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Mean Marker Expression —", analysis_label),
    x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Mean\nExpr"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "marker_mean_heatmap.png"),
  p_heatmap, width = 3.5, height = 1.5 + n_markers * 0.8, bg = "white"
)

# --- Single-cell expression heatmap (all cells, one column per cell) ---
# Rows = markers, columns = individual cells, split by condition
# Cells are sorted by mean expression within each condition for visual clarity
message("  Generating single-cell heatmap (", nrow(meta_df), " cells)...")

sc_wide <- cbind(meta_df, expr_mat)
sc_wide$cell_mean <- rowMeans(expr_mat, na.rm = TRUE)

# Sort within each condition by mean expression
sc_wide <- sc_wide %>%
  arrange(condition, cell_mean) %>%
  mutate(cell_rank = row_number())

sc_long <- sc_wide %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(unname(eval_markers)),
    names_to = "marker",
    values_to = "expression"
  )

# Cap extreme values for colour scale readability
expr_cap <- quantile(sc_long$expression, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)
sc_long$expression_capped <- pmin(sc_long$expression, expr_cap)

p_sc_heat <- ggplot(sc_long, aes(x = cell_rank, y = marker, fill = expression_capped)) +
  geom_raster() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", name = "Expr") +
  facet_grid(~ condition, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  labs(
    title = paste("Single-Cell Expression —", analysis_label),
    subtitle = paste(nrow(meta_df), "cells | sorted by mean expression within condition"),
    x = "Cells (sorted)", y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.3, "lines"),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "single_cell_expression_heatmap.png"),
  p_sc_heat, width = 14, height = 2 + n_markers * 0.8, dpi = 200, bg = "white"
)

# Positivity frequency
positivity_threshold <- 0.5
freq_summary <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(is_positive = expression > positivity_threshold) %>%
  group_by(condition, marker) %>%
  summarise(
    total_cells = n(),
    positive_cells = sum(is_positive, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_positive = (positive_cells / total_cells) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

write.csv(freq_summary, file.path(analysis_dir, "marker_positivity_frequency.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

p_freq <- ggplot(freq_summary, aes(x = marker, y = percent_positive, fill = condition)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge()) +
  labs(
    title = paste("Marker Positivity —", analysis_label, "(> 0.5 norm. expr.)"),
    x = "Marker", y = "% Positive Cells", fill = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(analysis_dir, "marker_positivity_frequency.png"), p_freq, width = 6, height = 5, bg = "white")
message("✓ Marker expression overview saved")

# ============================================================================
# PART 3: MARKER-THRESHOLD CLASSIFICATION
# Only runs when post-hoc gating was applied (gate_thresholds exists)
# ============================================================================
if (exists("gate_thresholds")) {
message("\n--- Part 3: Marker-Threshold Classification (", threshold_profile_name, ") ---")

# Apply all gates sequentially to all cells in domain
domain_all_meta <- as.data.frame(colData(domain_spe))
passes_gates <- rep(TRUE, ncol(domain_spe))

for (gate in threshold_gates) {
  if (is.na(gate$marker)) {
    message("  ⚠️ Skipping gate: marker not found")
    next
  }
  marker_expr <- assay(domain_spe[gate$marker, ], "norm")[1, ]
  if (gate$direction == "above") {
    passes_gates <- passes_gates & (marker_expr > gate$threshold)
  } else {
    passes_gates <- passes_gates & (marker_expr < gate$threshold)
  }
  message("  Gate: ", gate$marker, " ", gate$direction, " ", gate$threshold,
          " — ", sum(passes_gates), " cells pass")
}

domain_all_meta$threshold_class <- ifelse(
  passes_gates, threshold_profile_name, threshold_negative_name
)

# Cells not in any target type get labelled Non-target
is_any_interest <- domain_all_meta$cellType %in% cell_types_of_interest
domain_all_meta$threshold_class[!is_any_interest & !passes_gates] <- "Non-target"

threshold_breakdown <- domain_all_meta %>%
  group_by(imageID, condition, threshold_class) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(imageID, condition) %>%
  mutate(
    total_in_domain = sum(n_cells),
    proportion = n_cells / total_in_domain
  )

print(threshold_breakdown)
write.csv(
  threshold_breakdown,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "threshold_proportions.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

p_threshold <- ggplot(threshold_breakdown, aes(x = imageID, y = proportion, fill = threshold_class)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.5) +
  facet_grid(~condition, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(proportion > 0.01,
      scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1), "")),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = threshold_colors) +
  labs(
    title = paste(analysis_label, "— Marker-Threshold Classification"),
    subtitle = paste("Target profile:", threshold_profile_name),
    x = "Image", y = "Proportion", fill = "Classification"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 10),
    strip.text = element_blank()
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(analysis_dir, "threshold_proportions.png"),
  p_threshold, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white"
)

# --- Concordance: annotation vs threshold ---
# Use threshold_class column (already stored in dataframe) instead of bare passes_gates vector
concordance <- domain_all_meta %>%
  mutate(
    annotation_match = cellType %in% cell_types_of_interest,
    threshold_match = threshold_class == threshold_profile_name
  ) %>%
  filter(annotation_match | threshold_match) %>%
  group_by(imageID, annotation_match, threshold_match) %>%
  summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

write.csv(
  concordance,
  file.path(analysis_dir, "annotation_vs_threshold_concordance.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

message("✓ Threshold classification saved")
} else {
  message("\n--- Skipping Part 3: Marker-Threshold Classification (no gate_thresholds) ---")
}
message("\n=== Section 7.6.3 Complete ===")
message("All outputs in: ", analysis_dir)
```

## 7.7 Combining lisaClust with spicyR

We can use `spicyR` to quantify co-localization between different spatial domains identified by `lisaClust`, revealing higher-order tissue organization.

``` {r domains_colocalisation, fig.width=14, fig.height=7}
message("Analyzing co-localization within each spatial domain...")

# Source the external analysis script
source(paste0(PROG_DIR, "/Scripts/spatial_domain_analysis.R"))

# Ensure condition column is set (CAR vs EGFR)
if (!"condition" %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe))) {
  combined_spe$condition <- factor(ifelse(
    grepl("CAR", combined_spe$imageID), "CAR", "EGFR"
  ))
  message("Defined conditions: ", paste(levels(combined_spe$condition), collapse = ", "))
}

# Run the domain-specific analysis
domain_results <- run_domain_spicy_analysis(
  combined_spe = combined_spe,
  domain_col = "annotation", # Use corrected annotations
  condition_col = "condition",
  output_dir = file.path(domains_dir, "Colocalization"),
  radii = 100,
  min_cells = 200
)

message("✓ Domain-specific colocalization analysis complete.")
```


## 7.8 Additional Visualizations

In this section, we generate detailed visualizations to further explore the spatial domain results.

### 7.8.1 Marker Expression Heatmap by Cell Type and Image

We visualize the mean marker expression for each cell type, faceted by image, to ensure consistency in cell type definitions across samples.

``` {r detailed_visualizations, fig.width=16, fig.height=12}
message("Generating detailed visualizations...")

# 1. Heatmap of Marker Expression by Cell Type (Faceted by Image)

# Ensure clustering_markers exists
if (!exists("clustering_markers")) {
  message("  Defining clustering markers (fallback)...")
  # Try to retrieve from attribute (typically set during normalization)
  clustering_markers <- attr(combined_spe, "use_markers")

  if (is.null(clustering_markers)) {
    message("  Attribute 'use_markers' not found. Defining from rownames (excluding DNA/Isotype/Background).")
    # Fallback: exclude DNA and Isotype markers
    all_markers <- rownames(combined_spe)
    clustering_markers <- all_markers[!grepl("DNA|Isotype|Background", all_markers, ignore.case = TRUE)]
  }
}

if (exists("clustering_markers") && length(clustering_markers) > 0) {
  message("  Generating marker expression heatmaps per image...")

  # Calculate mean marker expression per cell type per image
  message("  Extracting marker data for ", length(clustering_markers), " markers...")

  # Subset to markers present in the object to be safe
  clustering_markers <- intersect(clustering_markers, rownames(combined_spe))

  # Extract intensities (Transposed: cells as rows, markers as columns)
  intensities <- as.data.frame(t(as.matrix(assay(combined_spe[clustering_markers, ], "norm"))))

  # Add metadata
  metadata <- as.data.frame(colData(combined_spe)[, c("imageID", "cellType")])
  heatmap_df <- cbind(metadata, intensities)

  # Aggregate
  heatmap_data <- heatmap_df %>%
    group_by(imageID, cellType) %>%
    summarise(across(all_of(clustering_markers), mean, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(clustering_markers),
      names_to = "marker",
      values_to = "expression"
    )

  # Create Heatmap
  p_heatmap <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = marker, y = cellType, fill = expression)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_wrap(~imageID, ncol = 1) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Marker Expression by Cell Type (Faceted by Image)",
      subtitle = "Mean normalized expression",
      x = "Marker",
      y = "Cell Type",
      fill = "Expression"
    )

  # Adjust midpoint dynamically
  p_heatmap <- p_heatmap + scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
    midpoint = mean(heatmap_data$expression, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  print(p_heatmap)

  # Save
  heatmap_file <- file.path(
    domains_dir,
    "marker_expression_heatmap_by_image.png"
  )
  ggsave(
    heatmap_file, p_heatmap,
    width = 16, height = 12, bg = "white"
  )
  message("
    Marker heatmap saved: ", basename(heatmap_file))
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1b. T-cell markers in B Cell Zone + T Cell Zone
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
message("\n  Domain-specific heatmaps...")

t_cell_types <- c(
  "Transgenic Tregs", "Endogenous Tregs",
  "Activated CD8+ T Cells",
  "Indeterminate Cells",
  "Exhausted T Cells",
  "Th2 T Cells",
  "IL10+ CD4+ T Cells",
  "Treg-APC Conjugates"
)
t_domains <- c("Treg_Zone", "T_Cell_Zone")

t_marker_patterns <- c(
  "CD4", "CD8a", "CXCR5", "PD1",
  "GFP", "Foxp3-PerCP", "Corrected-FoxP3",
  "CTLA", "IL4", "IL10-PerCP", "IL21",
  "IFNg", "Granzyme_A", "Granzyme_B", "Perforin"
)
t_markers <- unlist(lapply(
  t_marker_patterns,
  function(p) {
    m <- grep(p, clustering_markers,
              ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(m) > 0) m[1] else NA
  }
))
t_markers <- t_markers[!is.na(t_markers)]
t_markers <- unique(t_markers)

# Subset cells: T cell types in B Cell Zone or T Cell Zone
t_mask <- combined_spe$cellType %in% t_cell_types &
  combined_spe$annotation %in% t_domains
spe_t <- combined_spe[t_markers, t_mask]

if (ncol(spe_t) > 0) {
  t_int <- as.data.frame(
    t(as.matrix(assay(spe_t, "norm")))
  )
  t_meta <- as.data.frame(
    colData(spe_t)[, c("imageID", "cellType",
                       "annotation")]
  )
  t_df <- cbind(t_meta, t_int)

  t_hm <- t_df %>%
    group_by(imageID, annotation, cellType) %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(t_markers), mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(t_markers),
      names_to = "marker",
      values_to = "expression"
    )

  # Short marker labels
  t_hm$marker_short <- gsub(
    "-.*$", "", t_hm$marker
  )

  p_t_hm <- ggplot(
    t_hm,
    aes(x = cellType, y = marker_short,
        fill = expression)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
    facet_grid(annotation ~ imageID) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
      midpoint = mean(
        t_hm$expression, na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      name = "Expr"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "T Cell Markers: B Cell Zone + T Cell Zone",
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 2.5) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 2
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 2.5
      ),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 3, face = "bold"
      ),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 2.5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 2),
      plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1)
    )

  print(p_t_hm)
  # Size from grid: 0.12" per cell + overhead
  n_tcols <- length(unique(t_hm$cellType))
  n_trows <- length(unique(t_hm$marker_short))
  n_tfacet_x <- length(unique(t_hm$imageID))
  n_tfacet_y <- length(unique(t_hm$annotation))
  t_w <- n_tcols * n_tfacet_x * 0.12 + 0.8
  t_h <- n_trows * n_tfacet_y * 0.12 + 0.7
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      domains_dir,
      "tcell_marker_heatmap_GC_TregTfh.png"
    ),
    p_t_hm,
    width = t_w, height = t_h,
    dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message(
    "  Saved tcell_marker_heatmap_GC_TregTfh.png"
  )
}

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# 1c. B-cell activation markers: CAR vs EGFR
#     across B Cell Zone, B Cells + Activated B Cells
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
message("\n  B cell activation marker comparison...")

b_cell_types <- c("B Cells", "Activated B Cells")
b_domains <- c("B_Cell_Zone")
b_marker_patterns <- c(
  "CD40", "IA-IE", "PDL1|CD274"
)
b_markers <- unlist(lapply(
  b_marker_patterns,
  function(p) {
    m <- grep(p, clustering_markers,
              ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(m) > 0) m[1] else NA
  }
))
b_markers <- b_markers[!is.na(b_markers)]

# Subset and extract
b_mask <- combined_spe$cellType %in% b_cell_types &
  combined_spe$annotation %in% b_domains
spe_b <- combined_spe[b_markers, b_mask]

if (ncol(spe_b) > 0) {
  b_int <- as.data.frame(
    t(as.matrix(assay(spe_b, "norm")))
  )
  b_meta <- as.data.frame(
    colData(spe_b)[, c("imageID", "cellType",
                       "annotation")]
  )
  b_meta$condition <- ifelse(
    grepl("CAR", b_meta$imageID),
    "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg"
  )
  b_df <- cbind(b_meta, b_int)

  # Mean expression per group
  b_means <- b_df %>%
    group_by(
      condition, annotation, cellType
    ) %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        all_of(b_markers), mean, na.rm = TRUE
      ),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = all_of(b_markers),
      names_to = "marker",
      values_to = "expression"
    )
  b_means$marker_short <- gsub(
    "-.*$", "", b_means$marker
  )
  # Clean domain labels
  b_means$domain <- gsub(
    "_", " ", b_means$annotation
  )

  # --- Plot A: Paired dot plot (absolute values) ---
  message("    [A] Paired dot plot...")
  p_bdot <- ggplot(
    b_means,
    aes(x = expression, y = marker_short,
        color = condition)
  ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(group = interaction(
        marker_short, annotation, cellType
      )),
      color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    geom_point(size = 1.8) +
    facet_grid(
      domain ~ cellType
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "CAR-Treg" = "#377eb8",
        "EGFR-Treg" = "#e41a1c"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "B Cell Activation Markers",
      subtitle = "Mean normalized expression",
      x = "Expression", y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 6
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8, face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 2)
    )

  print(p_bdot)
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      domains_dir,
      "bcell_markers_paired_dot.png"
    ),
    p_bdot,
    width = 3.5, height = 2.5,
    dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("    Saved bcell_markers_paired_dot.png")

  # --- Plot B: Difference heatmap (CAR - EGFR) ---
  message("    [B] Difference heatmap...")
  b_wide <- b_means %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      id_cols = c(annotation, cellType,
                  marker, marker_short, domain),
      names_from = condition,
      values_from = expression
    )
  b_wide$delta <- b_wide$`CAR-Treg` -
    b_wide$`EGFR-Treg`

  max_abs <- max(abs(b_wide$delta), na.rm = TRUE)
  bcell_diff_max_abs <- max_abs

  p_bdiff <- ggplot(
    b_wide,
    aes(x = cellType, y = marker_short,
        fill = delta)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = sprintf("%+.2f", delta)),
      size = 1.8, color = "black"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ domain, nrow = 1) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#e41a1c", mid = "white",
      high = "#377eb8",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-max_abs, max_abs),
      name = "CAR\u2212EGFR"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "CAR vs EGFR Difference",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Blue = higher in CAR, ",
        "Red = higher in EGFR"
      ),
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 6
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8, face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )

  print(p_bdiff)
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      domains_dir,
      "bcell_markers_diff_heatmap.png"
    ),
    p_bdiff,
    width = 3.5, height = 2,
    dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("    Saved bcell_markers_diff_heatmap.png")

  # --- Plot C: Dodged bar chart of deltas ---
  message("    [C] Delta bar chart...")
  p_bbar <- ggplot(
    b_wide,
    aes(y = marker_short, x = delta,
        fill = cellType)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
      width = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 0,
      linewidth = 0.3, linetype = "dashed"
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(
        label = sprintf("%+.2f", delta),
        hjust = ifelse(delta >= 0, -0.1, 1.1)
      ),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
      size = 1.5
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ domain, ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "B Cells" = "#00008B",
        "Activated B Cells" = "#4169E1"
      ),
      name = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "CAR \u2212 EGFR Expression Delta",
      subtitle = paste0(
        "Right = higher in CAR, ",
        "left = higher in EGFR"
      ),
      y = NULL,
      x = "Expression Difference"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(
        face = "bold", size = 6
      ),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8, face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.key.size = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 4, 2, 2)
    )

  print(p_bbar)
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      domains_dir,
      "bcell_markers_delta_bars.png"
    ),
    p_bbar,
    width = 3, height = 2.5,
    dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("    Saved bcell_markers_delta_bars.png")
}

# 2. Updated Spatial Domain Composition (Stacked Bar Plot with Consistent Colors)
message("\n  Generating updated spatial domain composition plot...")

# Ensure consistant colors
if (!exists("celltype_colors")) {
  message("  Defining cell type colors (fallback)...")
  celltype_colors <- c(
    # Artifacts & low quality (greys)
    "Doublets/Multiplets" = "grey50",
    "Low-quality / Artifacts" = "grey35",
    "Indeterminate Cells" = "grey60",
    "Resting/Naive Lymphocytes" = "grey85",
    # Treg family (purples)
    "Transgenic Tregs" = "#8B008B", # darkmagenta
    "Endogenous Tregs" = "#9370DB", # mediumpurple
    "Treg-APC Conjugates" = "#BA55D3", # mediumorchid
    # B cells / APCs (blues)
    "B Cells" = "#00008B", # darkblue
    "Activated B Cells" = "#4169E1", # royalblue
    # T cells (oranges/reds)
    "Exhausted T Cells" = "#CD3700", # darkorange3
    "Activated CD8+ T Cells" = "#FF4500", # orangered
    # Th2 / cytokine-producing (yellows/greens)
    "Th2 T Cells" = "#2E8B57", # seagreen
    "IL10+ CD4+ T Cells" = "#00CD00" # green3
  )
}

# Reconstruct composition data from combined_spe if needed
if (!exists("domain_composition_annotated")) {
  message("  Reconstructing domain composition data from combined_spe...")
  if ("annotation" %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe))) {
    domain_composition_annotated <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
      as.data.frame() %>%
      group_by(imageID, annotation, cellType) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      group_by(imageID, annotation) %>%
      mutate(
        total = sum(n),
        proportion = n / total,
        domain_label = annotation # Use annotation directly
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else {
    message("  ⚠️  Annotation column not found in combined_spe. Cannot generate domain composition plot.")
    domain_composition_annotated <- NULL
  }
}

if (!is.null(domain_composition_annotated)) {
  # Check for missing colors
  missing_colors <- setdiff(unique(domain_composition_annotated$cellType), names(celltype_colors))
  if (length(missing_colors) > 0) {
    message("    ⚠️  Warning: Some cell types missing colors: ", paste(missing_colors, collapse = ", "))
  }

  comp_plot_colored <- ggplot(
    domain_composition_annotated,
    aes(x = domain_label, y = proportion, fill = cellType)
  ) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~imageID, ncol = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
    labs(
      title = "Spatial Domain Composition by Image (Consistent Colors)",
      subtitle = "Stacked bars show cell type proportions within each domain",
      x = "Spatial Domain",
      y = "Proportion of Cells",
      fill = "Cell Type"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    )

  print(comp_plot_colored)

  comp_file <- file.path(domains_dir, "spatial_domains_composition_comparison_colored.png")
  ggsave(comp_file, comp_plot_colored, width = 16, height = 10, bg = "white")
  message("  ✓ Updated composition plot saved to: ", basename(comp_file))

  # 3. Spatial Domain Composition Pie Charts per Domain
  message("\n  Generating pie charts for each spatial domain...")
  unique_domains <- unique(domain_composition_annotated$domain_label)

  for (domain_name in unique_domains) {
    # Subset data for the current domain and remove zero proportions for cleaner plots
    domain_data <- domain_composition_annotated %>%
      filter(domain_label == domain_name, proportion > 0)

    # Generate the pie chart
    pie_plot <- ggplot(domain_data, aes(x = "", y = proportion, fill = cellType)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
      coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
      facet_wrap(~imageID, ncol = 2) +
      scale_fill_manual(values = celltype_colors) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Cellular Composition:", domain_name),
        subtitle = "Pie chart of cell type proportions",
        fill = "Cell Type"
      ) +
      theme_void() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold")
      )

    # Clean the domain name for the filename (sanitize spaces/special characters)
    safe_domain_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", domain_name)

    pie_file <- file.path(domains_dir, paste0("spatial_domain_pie_", safe_domain_name, ".png"))
    ggsave(pie_file, pie_plot, width = 14, height = 8, bg = "white")
  }
  message("  ✓ Pie charts saved to: ", domains_dir)
}

## 7.8 Choosing the Optimal Number of Regions

For a more rigorous approach, you can test multiple values of `k` and use metrics like the Gap statistic or Silhouette score.

``` {r optimal_k_exploration, eval=FALSE}
# Test multiple values of k
k_values <- 3:8

message("Testing k values: ", paste(k_values, collapse = ", "))
message("Note: This can take several minutes...")

# Store results for each k
k_results <- list()

for (k in k_values) {
  message("\nTesting k = ", k)

  # Run lisaClust with this k
  spe_test <- lisaClust::lisaClust(
    combined_spe,
    k = k,
    Rs = c(20, 50, 100),
    sigma = 50,
    spatialCoords = c("x", "y"),
    cellType = "cellType",
    imageID = "imageID",
    BPPARAM = BPPARAM
  )

  # Calculate silhouette score (quality of clustering)
  # Higher silhouette = better defined clusters
  # This requires cluster package

  k_results[[as.character(k)]] <- spe_test
}

message("\n✓ Tested all k values")
message("Compare region maps to choose optimal k based on biological interpretation")

## 7.10 Quantifying Domain Interfaces

**Do different spatial departments boundary each other more frequently?**

We can quantify the length of the shared boundary between different spatial domains using Voronoi tessellation. This helps answer questions like "Are Treg zones more contiguous with B cell follicles in the treated condition?"

``` {r generate_boundary_distributions, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
message("\n=== Section 7.10: Domain Interface Analysis ===")

# Source the analysis function
source(paste0(PROG_DIR, "/Scripts/spatial_domain_analysis.R"))

# Run boundary calculation
# This returns a list with statistics and plotting data
# We run once to catch unfiltered patch areas and boundary segment lengths
boundary_results <- calculate_domain_boundaries(
  combined_spe,
  imageID_col = "imageID",
  domain_col = "annotation",
  output_dir = file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries"),
  min_patch_area = 500, # Exclude contiguous domain patches smaller than 500 pixels/units
  min_boundary_length = 5, # Exclude Voronoi borders between isolated single cells shorter than 5 units
  BPPARAM = BPPARAM
)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# OPTIONAL: Cache Voronoi Topology for Interactive Threshold Evaluation
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!requireNamespace("qs", quietly = TRUE)) BiocManager::install("qs", update = FALSE)
qs::qsave(boundary_results, file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", "boundary_results_voronoi.qs"))
message("✓ Saved boundary_results to ", file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", "boundary_results_voronoi.qs"))

# Note: You can now load the qs object directly from memory without waiting 10 minutes:
# boundary_results <- qs::qread(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", "boundary_results_voronoi.qs"))
#
# To filter visually immediately after tessellation:
min_area <- 10000
valid_patches <- boundary_results$raw_patches %>%
  filter(total_area >= min_area) %>%
  pull(patch_id)
boundary_results$raw_edges <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>% filter(patch1 %in% valid_patches & patch2 %in% valid_patches)
# target_interaction will adjust downstream automatically!
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Pairwise boundary pairs to analyze ---
# REVIEW REQUIRED: Domain names below (Treg_Zone, T_Cell_Zone) may change
# after re-running lisaClust with cluster-only cell types. Update if needed.
pair_list <- list(
  list(d1 = "B_Cell_Zone", d2 = "Treg_Zone",   tag = "BCZ_TRZ", label = "B Cell Zone \u2194 Treg Zone"),
  list(d1 = "B_Cell_Zone", d2 = "T_Cell_Zone",  tag = "BCZ_TCZ", label = "B Cell Zone \u2194 T Cell Zone")
)

# Colors for each boundary type on the combined spatial map
boundary_pair_cols <- c(
  "B_Cell_Zone <-> Treg_Zone"   = "#FF0000",  # bright red
  "B_Cell_Zone <-> T_Cell_Zone" = "#00E5CC"   # bright turquoise
)

# Plot generated raw empirical distributions to validate filtering thresholds
message("\nGenerating distribution plots of un-filtered raw areas and edges...")

for (dist_idx in seq_along(pair_list)) {
  pair <- pair_list[[dist_idx]]
  message("\n--- Distributions [", dist_idx, "/", length(pair_list), "]: ", pair$label, " ---")

  if (!is.null(boundary_results$raw_patches) && nrow(boundary_results$raw_patches) > 0) {
    target_patch_areas <- boundary_results$raw_patches %>%
      filter(domain %in% c(pair$d1, pair$d2))
    message("  Patch areas: ", nrow(target_patch_areas), " patches for ", pair$d1, " + ", pair$d2)

    if (nrow(target_patch_areas) > 0) {
      p_area <- ggplot(target_patch_areas, aes(x = total_area, fill = domain)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
        scale_fill_manual(values = annot_cols) +
        scale_x_log10() +
        facet_wrap(~imageID) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = paste0("Distribution of Patch Areas (", pair$label, ")"),
             x = "Log10(Patch Area)", y = "Count")
      print(p_area)
      ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Patch_Areas_Distribution.png")),
             p_area, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "white")
      message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Patch_Areas_Distribution.png")
    }
  }

  if (!is.null(boundary_results$raw_edges) && nrow(boundary_results$raw_edges) > 0) {
    target_edges <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
      filter(domain1 %in% c(pair$d1, pair$d2) &
             domain2 %in% c(pair$d1, pair$d2) &
             domain1 != domain2)
    message("  Boundary edges: ", nrow(target_edges), " cross-domain edges")

    if (nrow(target_edges) > 0) {
      p_length <- ggplot(target_edges, aes(x = length)) +
        geom_histogram(bins = 50, alpha = 0.6, fill = "red") +
        scale_x_log10() +
        facet_wrap(~imageID) +
        theme_minimal() +
        labs(title = paste0("Distribution of Shared Boundary Edge Lengths (", pair$label, ")"),
             x = "Log10(Boundary Edge Length)", y = "Count")
      print(p_length)
      ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Boundary_Lengths_Distribution.png")),
             p_length, width = 10, height = 8, bg = "white")
      message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Boundary_Lengths_Distribution.png")
    }
  }
}
```

``` {r domain_boundaries, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
# Extract statistics
boundary_stats <- boundary_results$stats

has_stats <- !is.null(boundary_stats) && nrow(boundary_stats) > 0
if (!has_stats) {
  message("\u26a0\ufe0f  No boundary stats found.")
}

# --- Shared computations (pair-independent) ---
image_fill <- c("CAR_TREG_1" = "#377eb8", "CAR_TREG_2" = "#377eb8",
                "EGFR_TREG_1" = "#e41a1c", "EGFR_TREG_2" = "#e41a1c")

has_raw_edges <- !is.null(boundary_results$raw_edges) && "patch1" %in% colnames(boundary_results$raw_edges)

if (has_stats) {
  total_tissue_perimeters <- boundary_stats %>%
    select(imageID, source_domain, total_perimeter) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(imageID) %>%
    summarise(tissue_perimeter = sum(total_perimeter), .groups = "drop")
}

if (has_raw_edges) {
  patch_perimeters <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(patch1, patch2), values_to = "patch_id", names_to = "patch_side") %>%
    group_by(imageID, patch_id) %>%
    summarise(total_perimeter = sum(length), .groups = "drop")

  min_pct_perimeter <- 10
}

# =========================================================================
# Loop over all pairwise domain boundaries
# =========================================================================
all_diverging_data <- list()

for (pair_idx in seq_along(pair_list)) {
  pair <- pair_list[[pair_idx]]
  message("\n", strrep("=", 60))
  message("  Boundary pair [", pair_idx, "/", length(pair_list), "]: ", pair$label)
  message("  Domains: ", pair$d1, " vs ", pair$d2)
  message("  File prefix: ", pair$tag)
  message(strrep("=", 60))

  # --- Filter target interaction from stats ---
  if (!has_stats) {
    message("  SKIP: No boundary stats available — cannot process this pair.")
    next
  }

  message("  Filtering boundary_stats for ", pair$d1, " <-> ", pair$d2, "...")
  target_interaction <- boundary_stats %>%
    filter(
      (source_domain == pair$d1 & target_domain == pair$d2) |
      (source_domain == pair$d2 & target_domain == pair$d1)
    )

  if (nrow(target_interaction) == 0) {
    message("  \u26a0\ufe0f  No boundary data for ", pair$label, " — skipping entire pair.")
    message("  Available domains: ", paste(unique(boundary_stats$source_domain), collapse = ", "))
    next
  }

  message("  \u2713 Found ", nrow(target_interaction), " stat rows for: ", pair$label)
  message("  Images represented: ", paste(unique(target_interaction$imageID), collapse = ", "))
  print(target_interaction)

  # --- Shared Boundary Bar Plot ---
  message("\n  [1/8] Generating shared boundary bar plot...")
  p_boundary_bar <- ggplot(target_interaction, aes(x = imageID, y = pct_shared_boundary, fill = imageID)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = image_fill) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Shared Boundary: ", pair$label),
      subtitle = "Percentage of Source Domain perimeter shared with Target Domain",
      y = "% Shared Boundary",
      x = "Image"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~source_domain, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_boundary_bar)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Shared_Boundary.png")),
         p_boundary_bar, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Shared_Boundary.png")

  # --- Absolute shared boundary data (used in diverging bar chart below) ---
  boundary_abs_data <- target_interaction %>%
    filter(source_domain == pair$d1) %>%
    select(imageID, value = shared_length)

  # --- Interaction Density (normalized to total tissue perimeter) ---
  message("\n  [2/8] Generating interaction density plot...")
  target_interaction_density <- target_interaction %>%
    left_join(total_tissue_perimeters, by = "imageID") %>%
    mutate(interaction_density = (shared_length / tissue_perimeter) * 1000)

  p_boundary_density <- ggplot(
    target_interaction_density %>% filter(source_domain == pair$d1),
    aes(x = imageID, y = interaction_density, fill = imageID)
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = image_fill) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Interaction Density: ", pair$label),
      subtitle = "Shared length normalized by total tissue perimeter (per 1000 units)",
      y = "Density Score",
      x = "Image"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_boundary_density)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Interaction_Density.png")),
         p_boundary_density, width = 6, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Interaction_Density.png")

  # --- Micro-Boundary Interface Distributions ---
  message("\n  [3/8] Computing micro-boundary interfaces (min_pct_perimeter = ", min_pct_perimeter, "%)...")
  if (!has_raw_edges) {
    message("  SKIP: No raw edges available — skipping micro-boundary analysis for this pair.")
    next
  }

  # Pre-build lookup tables with unambiguous column names
  perim_a <- patch_perimeters
  colnames(perim_a) <- c("imageID", "patch_a", "perimeter_a")
  perim_b <- patch_perimeters
  colnames(perim_b) <- c("imageID", "patch_b", "perimeter_b")

  micro_edges <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
    filter((domain1 == pair$d1 & domain2 == pair$d2) |
           (domain1 == pair$d2 & domain2 == pair$d1)) %>%
    mutate(
      patch_a = ifelse(domain1 == pair$d1, patch1, patch2),
      patch_b = ifelse(domain1 == pair$d2, patch1, patch2)
    ) %>%
    group_by(imageID, patch_a, patch_b) %>%
    summarise(interface_length = sum(length), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(perim_a, by = c("imageID", "patch_a")) %>%
    left_join(perim_b, by = c("imageID", "patch_b")) %>%
    mutate(
      pct_perimeter = (interface_length / (perimeter_a + perimeter_b)) * 100
    ) %>%
    filter(pct_perimeter >= min_pct_perimeter)

  if (nrow(micro_edges) == 0) {
    message("  \u26a0\ufe0f  No micro-boundaries for ", pair$label, " after filtering — skipping plots 4-8.")
    next
  }

  message("  \u2713 ", nrow(micro_edges), " micro-boundary interfaces for ", pair$label)
  message("  Images with micro-boundaries: ", paste(unique(micro_edges$imageID), collapse = ", "))

  # --- Wilcoxon tests ---
  message("\n  [4/8] Running Wilcoxon rank-sum tests...")
  images <- unique(micro_edges$imageID)
  test_subtitle_abs <- "Distribution of independent contiguous interaction footprints"
  test_subtitle_norm <- test_subtitle_abs
  if (length(images) >= 2) {
    condition_vec <- ifelse(grepl("CAR", unique(micro_edges$imageID)), "CAR", "EGFR")
    can_test <- length(unique(condition_vec)) == 2

    if (can_test) {
      message("  Running Wilcoxon tests (", length(images), " images, both conditions represented)...")
      test_res_abs <- wilcox.test(interface_length ~ imageID, data = micro_edges)
      test_subtitle_abs <- paste0(test_subtitle_abs, " (Wilcoxon p = ", signif(test_res_abs$p.value, 3), ")")

      test_res_norm <- wilcox.test(pct_perimeter ~ imageID, data = micro_edges)
      test_subtitle_norm <- paste0(test_subtitle_norm, " (Wilcoxon p = ", signif(test_res_norm$p.value, 3), ")")
    } else {
      message("  Skipping Wilcoxon: insufficient conditions (need both CAR and EGFR with data).")
    }
  } else {
    message("  Skipping Wilcoxon: only ", length(images), " image(s) with micro-boundaries.")
  }

  # --- Diverging Bar Chart: Boundary Metrics ---
  message("\n  [5/8] Generating diverging bar chart (boundary length + micro-boundary count)...")
  interaction_counts <- micro_edges %>%
    group_by(imageID) %>%
    summarise(interaction_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  diverging_data <- bind_rows(
    boundary_abs_data %>%
      mutate(metric = "Shared Boundary\nLength"),
    interaction_counts %>%
      select(imageID, value = interaction_count) %>%
      mutate(metric = "Micro-Boundary\nCount")
  )

  diverging_data <- diverging_data %>%
    mutate(condition = ifelse(grepl("CAR", imageID), "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg")) %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(normalized = value / max(value)) %>%
    ungroup()

  diverging_summary <- diverging_data %>%
    group_by(metric, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_norm = mean(normalized),
      mean_raw = mean(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      y_val = ifelse(condition == "CAR-Treg", mean_norm, -mean_norm),
      label = ifelse(
        grepl("Length", metric),
        paste0(round(mean_raw / 1000, 0), "K"),
        as.character(round(mean_raw, 0))
      ),
      label_y = ifelse(condition == "CAR-Treg", y_val + 0.08, y_val - 0.08)
    )

  all_diverging_data[[pair_idx]] <- diverging_summary %>%
    mutate(pair_label = pair$label)

  p_diverging <- ggplot(diverging_summary, aes(x = metric, y = y_val, fill = condition)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5, color = "grey30") +
    geom_text(aes(y = label_y, label = label), size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("CAR-Treg" = "#377eb8", "EGFR-Treg" = "#e41a1c"),
      name = "Condition"
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      breaks = c(-0.5, 0, 0.5),
      labels = c("EGFR-Treg", "", "CAR-Treg"),
      limits = c(-1.2, 1.2)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Boundary Metrics: ", pair$label),
      subtitle = "Normalized comparison (bar height = proportion of max value)",
      x = NULL,
      y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
    )

  print(p_diverging)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Boundary_Metrics.png")),
         p_diverging, width = 4, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Boundary_Metrics.png")

  # --- Absolute Micro-Boundary Violin ---
  message("\n  [6/8] Generating absolute micro-boundary violin plot...")
  p_micro_violin_abs <- ggplot(micro_edges, aes(x = imageID, y = interface_length, fill = imageID)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, size = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = image_fill) +
    scale_y_log10() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Absolute Micro-Boundary Distributions: ", pair$label),
      subtitle = test_subtitle_abs,
      y = "Log10(Interface Edge Length)",
      x = "Image"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_micro_violin_abs)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Violin_Abs.png")),
         p_micro_violin_abs, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Violin_Abs.png")

  # --- Normalized Micro-Boundary Violin ---
  message("\n  [7/8] Generating normalized micro-boundary violin plot...")
  p_micro_violin_norm <- ggplot(micro_edges, aes(x = imageID, y = pct_perimeter, fill = imageID)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, size = 1, color = "black") +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, fill = "white", alpha = 0.8, outlier.shape = NA) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = image_fill) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Normalized Micro-Boundary Distributions: ", pair$label),
      subtitle = test_subtitle_norm,
      y = "% of Combined Patch Perimeter",
      x = "Image"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_micro_violin_norm)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Violin_Norm.png")),
         p_micro_violin_norm, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Violin_Norm.png")

  # --- Normalized Micro-Boundary Histogram ---
  message("\n  [8/8] Generating normalized micro-boundary histogram...")
  p_micro_hist_norm <- ggplot(micro_edges, aes(x = pct_perimeter, fill = imageID)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.6, position = "identity", bins = 50, color = "black") +
    facet_wrap(~imageID, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = image_fill) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Normalized Micro-Boundary Histogram: ", pair$label),
      y = "Frequency",
      x = "% of Combined Patch Perimeter"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(legend.position = "none")

  print(p_micro_hist_norm)
  ggsave(file.path(domains_dir, "Boundaries", paste0(pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Hist_Norm.png")),
         p_micro_hist_norm, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved ", pair$tag, "_Micro_Boundary_Hist_Norm.png")

  message("\n  \u2713 Pair [", pair_idx, "/", length(pair_list), "] complete: ", pair$label)
}

# Build rows with numeric y (top = highest y)
# Layout: title row, then entries, per section
rows <- list()

# Helper to add a section
add_section <- function(title, labels, colors,
                        shape_code, y_start) {
  # Title row
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
    y = y_start, label = title,
    color = "black", shape_num = NA,
    is_title = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (i in seq_along(labels)) {
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      y = y_start - i,
      label = labels[i],
      color = colors[i],
      shape_num = shape_code,
      is_title = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  # Return next y start (gap for separator)
  y_start - length(labels) - 1.5
}

y_pos <- 0

    aes(
      x = -0.2, xend = 12,
      y = y, yend = y
    ),

  ) +

  ) +
