### 7.11.1 B Cell Activation Heatmaps

Mean expression of PDL1, MHC-II, and CD40 in B Cells and Activated B Cells, comparing CAR vs EGFR.

``` {r sandbox_heatmaps, fig.width=5, fig.height=3}
hm_markers <- sb_markers[c("PDL1", "MHCII", "CD40")]

# Cell masks based on cellType annotations:
#   Total B Cells = "B Cells" + "Activated B Cells" combined
#   Activated B Cells = "Activated B Cells" only
is_total_b <- combined_spe$cellType %in% c("B Cells", "Activated B Cells")
is_act_b   <- combined_spe$cellType == "Activated B Cells"

# Build a diff heatmap with both B cell populations as columns
# Mirrors the layout from bcell_markers_diff_heatmap.png
build_bcell_diff_heatmap <- function(spe_obj, scope_label,
                                     markers, cell_masks,
                                     scale_limit = NULL) {
  delta_rows <- list()
  for (pop_name in names(cell_masks)) {
    mask <- cell_masks[[pop_name]]
    if (sum(mask) == 0) next
    spe_ct <- spe_obj[unname(markers), mask]
    expr_mat <- as.matrix(assay(spe_ct, "norm"))
    rownames(expr_mat) <- names(markers)
    cond <- spe_ct$condition
    car_cols <- which(cond == "CAR")
    egfr_cols <- which(cond == "EGFR")
    if (length(car_cols) == 0 || length(egfr_cols) == 0) next
    delta_rows[[pop_name]] <- data.frame(
      cellType = pop_name,
      marker = names(markers),
      delta = rowMeans(expr_mat[, egfr_cols, drop = FALSE]) -
        rowMeans(expr_mat[, car_cols, drop = FALSE]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (length(delta_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

  delta_df <- do.call(rbind, delta_rows)
  delta_df$marker <- factor(
    delta_df$marker, levels = names(markers)
  )
  delta_df$cellType <- factor(
    delta_df$cellType, levels = names(cell_masks)
  )

  lim <- if (!is.null(scale_limit)) {
    scale_limit
  } else {
    max(abs(delta_df$delta), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  ggplot(
    delta_df,
    aes(x = cellType, y = marker, fill = delta)
  ) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#377eb8", mid = "white",
      high = "#e41a1c",
      midpoint = 0,
      limits = c(-lim, lim),
      name = "EGFR\u2212CAR"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = scope_label,
      subtitle = "EGFR\u2212CAR",
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 5
      ),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.title = element_text(
        size = 8, face = "bold"
      ),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 5),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.key.height = unit(0.3, "cm"),
      legend.key.width = unit(0.15, "cm"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 5),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 4),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
    )
}

# Two heatmaps: Whole Tissue and B Cell Zone
# Each has Activated B Cells + B Cells as columns
hm_scopes <- list(
  list(scope = "Whole Tissue", domain = FALSE,
       tag = "diff_whole"),
  list(scope = "B Cell Zone", domain = TRUE,
       tag = "diff_BCZ")
)

hm_lim <- if (exists("bcell_diff_max_abs")) {
  bcell_diff_max_abs
} else {
  NULL
}

for (sc in hm_scopes) {
  message("\n  Diff heatmap: ", sc$scope)
  masks <- list(
    "Activated B" = is_act_b,
    "B Cells" = combined_spe$cellType == "B Cells"
  )
  if (sc$domain) {
    in_zone <- combined_spe$annotation == "B_Cell_Zone"
    masks <- lapply(masks, function(m) m & in_zone)
  }
  n_cells <- sum(Reduce(`|`, masks))
  if (n_cells == 0) {
    message("  No cells — skipping")
    next
  }
  message("  Cells: ", format(n_cells, big.mark = ","))
  p <- build_bcell_diff_heatmap(
    combined_spe, sc$scope, hm_markers, masks,
    scale_limit = hm_lim
  )
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        sandbox_heatmap_dir,
        paste0("heatmap_", sc$tag, ".png")
      ),
      p, width = 1.2, height = 1.0,
      dpi = 300, bg = "white"
    )
  }
}
message("\n\u2713 Heatmaps saved to: ", basename(sandbox_heatmap_dir))
```

### 7.11.2 CD40 Distribution Comparisons (failed to produce satisfactory results)

Initial attempts at histograms and scatter plots — the negative-expression bulk dominates axes, squashing the positive peak. Kept for reference; see 7.11.2.1 for improved alternatives.

``` {r sandbox_cd40_distributions, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (!exists("gate_thresholds")) {
  message("Skipping 7.11.2 — requires gate_thresholds from post-hoc gating")
} else {
cd40_ch <- sb_markers["CD40"]
cd19_ch <- sb_markers["CD19"]
cd40_thresh <- gate_thresholds$CD40
cd19_thresh <- gate_thresholds$CD19

cond_cols <- c("CAR" = "#377eb8", "EGFR" = "#e41a1c")

# --- Helper: extract expression for a cell subset ---
build_expr_df <- function(spe_sub) {
  data.frame(
    cd40 = assay(spe_sub[cd40_ch, ], "norm")[1, ],
    cd19 = assay(spe_sub[cd19_ch, ], "norm")[1, ],
    condition = spe_sub$condition,
    imageID = spe_sub$imageID,
    cellType = spe_sub$cellType,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Build data frames: whole tissue CD19+ and B_Cell_Zone CD19+
cd19_mask <- assay(combined_spe[cd19_ch, ], "norm")[1, ] > cd19_thresh

expr_whole <- build_expr_df(combined_spe[, cd19_mask])
expr_bcz <- build_expr_df(
  combined_spe[, cd19_mask & combined_spe$annotation == "B_Cell_Zone"]
)

# --- 2a/2b: CD40 histograms, overlaid by condition ---
# sqrt y-axis compresses the tall negative peak so the positive peak is visible
plot_cd40_hist <- function(df, scope_label, tag) {
  x_min <- cd40_thresh - 1.5
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cd40, fill = condition)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 100, alpha = 0.5, position = "identity"
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = cd40_thresh,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cond_cols) +
    scale_y_sqrt() +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_min, NA)) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("CD40 Expression (CD19+ cells) — ",
                      scope_label),
      subtitle = paste0("Threshold: ", round(cd40_thresh, 2)),
      x = "Normalized CD40 Expression", y = "Count (sqrt scale)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(sandbox_cd40_dir,
                   paste0("cd40_histogram_", tag, ".png")),
         p, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved cd40_histogram_", tag, ".png")
}

message("\nCD40 Histograms...")
plot_cd40_hist(expr_whole, "Whole Tissue", "whole")
plot_cd40_hist(expr_bcz, "B Cell Zone", "BCZ")

# --- 2c/2d: CD19 vs CD40 dot plots (zoomed to positive quadrant) ---
# Crop axes to start just below each threshold so the positive
# cells of interest fill the plot area
plot_cd19_cd40_scatter <- function(df, scope_label, tag) {
  x_lo <- max(cd19_thresh - 2, 0)
  y_lo <- max(cd40_thresh - 2, 0)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = cd19, y = cd40)) +
    geom_bin2d(bins = 150) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(
      option = "inferno", trans = "log10",
      name = "Cells"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = cd40_thresh,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = cd19_thresh,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.6
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(xlim = c(x_lo, NA), ylim = c(y_lo, NA)) +
    facet_wrap(~condition) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("CD19 vs CD40 — ", scope_label),
      x = "Normalized CD19", y = "Normalized CD40"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
  print(p)
  ggsave(file.path(sandbox_cd40_dir,
                   paste0("cd19_cd40_scatter_", tag, ".png")),
         p, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  message("  \u2713 Saved cd19_cd40_scatter_", tag, ".png")
}

# For scatter: use all cells (not just CD19+) to show the quadrants
expr_all_whole <- build_expr_df(combined_spe)
expr_all_bcz <- build_expr_df(
  combined_spe[, combined_spe$annotation == "B_Cell_Zone"]
)

message("\nCD19 vs CD40 Scatter Plots...")

plot_cd19_cd40_scatter(expr_all_bcz, "B Cell Zone", "BCZ")

message("\n\u2713 CD40 distribution plots saved to: ",
        basename(sandbox_cd40_dir))
} # end gate_thresholds guard (7.11.2)
```

``` {r sandbox_cd40_improved, fig.width=3, fig.height=3}
plot_cd40_ecdf <- function(df, scope_label, tag) {

# ── Plot B: Jitter + Boxplot (Activated B Cells only) ──
# Shows CD40 intensity for the gated population
plot_cd40_beeswarm <- function(spe_sub, scope_label,
                               tag) {
  act_mask <- spe_sub$cellType == "Activated B Cells"
  act_spe <- spe_sub[, act_mask]
  df <- data.frame(
    cd40 = assay(act_spe[cd40_ch, ], "norm")[1, ],
    condition = act_spe$condition,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  n_car <- sum(df$condition == "CAR")
  n_egfr <- sum(df$condition == "EGFR")

  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(x = condition, y = cd40, color = condition)
  ) +
    geom_boxplot(
      width = 0.4, outlier.shape = NA,
      color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4
    ) +
    geom_jitter(
      width = 0.2, alpha = 0.25, size = 0.15
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      yintercept = cd40_thresh,
      linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50",
      linewidth = 0.3
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cond_cols) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Act. B Cells — ", scope_label
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        "CAR n=", n_car,
        " | EGFR n=", n_egfr
      ),
      x = NULL, y = "CD40 Expression"
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 7) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 6),
      plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, "pt"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 6)
    )
  print(p)
  ggsave(
    file.path(
      sandbox_cd40_dir,
      paste0("cd40_beeswarm_", tag, ".png")
    ),
    p, width = 2, height = 2.5,
    dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("  saved cd40_beeswarm_", tag, ".png")
}
```

### 7.11.3 Focused Boundary Maps

Spatial boundary maps highlighting individual domain boundaries in red.

``` {r sandbox_boundary_maps, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
boundary_focus_pairs <- list(
  list(
    d1 = "B_Cell_Zone", d2 = "Treg_Zone",
    pair_key = "B_Cell_Zone <-> Treg_Zone",
    label = "B Cell Zone / Treg Zone",
    tag = "BCZ_TregZ"
  ),
  list(
    d1 = "B_Cell_Zone", d2 = "T_Cell_Zone",
    pair_key = "B_Cell_Zone <-> T_Cell_Zone",
    label = "B Cell Zone / T Cell Zone",
    tag = "BCZ_TCZ"
  )
)

if (!is.null(boundary_results$plot_data)) {
  for (bp in boundary_focus_pairs) {
    message("\nBoundary map: ", bp$label)
    focus_domains <- c(bp$d1, bp$d2)
    focus_colors <- annot_cols[focus_domains]

    map_plots <- list()
    for (img in names(boundary_results$plot_data)) {
      message("  Image: ", img)
      edges <- boundary_results$plot_data[[img]]
      boundary_edges <- edges %>% filter(type == "Boundary")

      # Target pair edges only
      target_edges <- boundary_edges %>%
        filter(pair == bp$pair_key)
      message("    Target boundary edges: ", nrow(target_edges))

      # Cell coordinates — color two domains, grey rest
      spe_sub <- combined_spe[, combined_spe$imageID == img]
      cell_coords <- as.data.frame(spatialCoords(spe_sub))
      cell_coords$domain <- ifelse(
        spe_sub$annotation %in% focus_domains,
        as.character(spe_sub$annotation),
        "Other"
      )

      domain_color_map <- c(
        focus_colors, "Other" = "#E8E8E8"
      )
      edge_col <- boundary_pair_cols[bp$pair_key]

      n_cells <- nrow(cell_coords)
      p <- ggplot(
        cell_coords,
        aes(x = x, y = y, color = domain)
      ) +
        geom_point(size = 0.01, alpha = 0.5)

      if (nrow(target_edges) > 0) {
        p <- p +
          geom_segment(
            data = target_edges,
            aes(
              x = x1, y = y1,
              xend = x2, yend = y2
            ),
            color = edge_col,
            linewidth = 0.6,
            alpha = 0.9,
            inherit.aes = FALSE
          )
      }

      p <- p +
        scale_color_manual(
          values = domain_color_map,
          drop = FALSE
        ) +
        labs(
          title = img,
          subtitle = paste0(
            format(n_cells, big.mark = ","),
            " cells"
          ),
          x = "X coordinate",
          y = "Y coordinate",
          color = "Spatial Domain"
        ) +
        theme_classic() +
        theme(
          aspect.ratio = 1,
          legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(
            size = 11, face = "bold"
          )
        ) +
        coord_fixed()

      map_plots[[img]] <- p
    }

    # Extract shared legend (matching domain maps)
    legend_src <- map_plots[[1]] +
      theme(legend.position = "right") +
      guides(color = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          size = 4, alpha = 1
        )
      ))
    map_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(legend_src)

    plots_grid <- cowplot::plot_grid(
      plotlist = map_plots, ncol = 2
    )
    p_combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
      plots_grid, map_legend,
      nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 0.2)
    )

    print(p_combined)
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        sandbox_boundary_dir,
        paste0("boundary_", bp$tag, ".png")
      ),
      p_combined,
      width = 18, height = 8,
      dpi = 300, bg = "white"
    )
    message("  Saved boundary_", bp$tag, ".png")
  }
} else {
  message("No boundary_results$plot_data available — ",
          "run section 7.10 first")
}

message("\n\u2713 Boundary maps saved to: ",
        basename(sandbox_boundary_dir))

# ── Focused Boundary Bar Plots ──
# Single-pair version of Combined_Boundary_Metrics_PerPair.png
message("\nGenerating focused boundary bar plots...")

if (has_stats && has_raw_edges) {
  for (bp in boundary_focus_pairs) {
    message("  Bar plots: ", bp$label)

    # Absolute boundary length from boundary_stats
    target_int <- boundary_stats %>%
      filter(
        (source_domain == bp$d1 & target_domain == bp$d2) |
        (source_domain == bp$d2 & target_domain == bp$d1)
      )
    if (nrow(target_int) == 0) {
      message("    No boundary stats — skipping")
      next
    }
    boundary_abs <- target_int %>%
      filter(source_domain == bp$d1) %>%
      select(imageID, value = shared_length)

    # Micro-boundary count from raw_edges
    perim_a <- patch_perimeters
    colnames(perim_a) <- c("imageID", "patch_a", "perimeter_a")
    perim_b <- patch_perimeters
    colnames(perim_b) <- c("imageID", "patch_b", "perimeter_b")

    focus_micro <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
      filter(
        (domain1 == bp$d1 & domain2 == bp$d2) |
        (domain1 == bp$d2 & domain2 == bp$d1)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        patch_a = ifelse(domain1 == bp$d1, patch1, patch2),
        patch_b = ifelse(domain1 == bp$d2, patch1, patch2)
      ) %>%
      group_by(imageID, patch_a, patch_b) %>%
      summarise(
        interface_length = sum(length),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      left_join(perim_a, by = c("imageID", "patch_a")) %>%
      left_join(perim_b, by = c("imageID", "patch_b")) %>%
      mutate(
        pct_perimeter = (interface_length /
          (perimeter_a + perimeter_b)) * 100
      ) %>%
      filter(pct_perimeter >= min_pct_perimeter)

    if (nrow(focus_micro) == 0) {
      message("    No micro-boundaries — skipping")
      next
    }

    interaction_counts <- focus_micro %>%
      group_by(imageID) %>%
      summarise(interaction_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

    focus_data <- bind_rows(
      boundary_abs %>%
        mutate(metric = "Shared Boundary\nLength"),
      interaction_counts %>%
        select(imageID, value = interaction_count) %>%
        mutate(metric = "Micro-Boundary\nCount")
    ) %>%
      mutate(
        condition = ifelse(
          grepl("CAR", imageID),
          "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg"
        )
      ) %>%
      group_by(metric) %>%
      mutate(normalized = value / max(value)) %>%
      ungroup()

    focus_summary <- focus_data %>%
      group_by(metric, condition) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_norm = mean(normalized),
        mean_raw = mean(value),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        label = ifelse(
          grepl("Length", metric),
          paste0(round(mean_raw / 1000, 0), "K"),
          as.character(round(mean_raw, 0))
        ),
        pair_label = bp$label
      )

    p_focus_bar <- ggplot(
      focus_summary,
      aes(
        y = pair_label, x = mean_norm,
        fill = condition
      )
    ) +
      geom_col(
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
        width = 0.6
      ) +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = label),
        position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
        hjust = -0.1, size = 2.8, fontface = "bold"
      ) +
      facet_wrap(~ metric, nrow = 1) +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "CAR-Treg" = "#377eb8",
          "EGFR-Treg" = "#e41a1c"
        ),
        name = "Condition"
      ) +
      scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 1.25),
        labels = scales::percent
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Boundary Metrics: ", bp$label),
        subtitle = "Per-pair normalization",
        x = "Normalized Value", y = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "right",
        axis.text.y = element_text(
          size = 7, face = "bold"
        ),
        plot.title = element_text(
          size = 10, face = "bold"
        ),
        strip.text = element_text(
          size = 9, face = "bold"
        )
      )

    print(p_focus_bar)
    ggsave(
      file.path(
        sandbox_boundary_dir,
        paste0("boundary_metrics_", bp$tag, ".png")
      ),
      p_focus_bar,
      width = 10, height = 2.5, bg = "white"
    )
    message("    Saved boundary_metrics_", bp$tag, ".png")
  }
} else {
  message("  Skipping: boundary stats or raw edges unavailable")
}

# ── Sandbox Master Legend ──
# Full Cell Type + Spatial Domain sections (matching 7.10)
# Updated Boundary section: only BCZ <-> Treg_Zone
message("\nGenerating sandbox master legend...")

sb_rows <- list()
sb_y <- 0

sb_add_section <- function(title, labels, colors,
                           shape_code, y_start) {
  sb_rows[[length(sb_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
    y = y_start, label = title,
    color = "black", shape_num = NA,
    is_title = TRUE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  for (i in seq_along(labels)) {
    sb_rows[[length(sb_rows) + 1]] <<- data.frame(
      y = y_start - i,
      label = labels[i],
      color = colors[i],
      shape_num = shape_code,
      is_title = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  y_start - length(labels) - 1.5
}

# Cell Type section (same as master)
sb_y <- sb_add_section(
  "Cell Type",
  names(ct_cols_present),
  ct_cols_present, 16, sb_y
)
sb_sep_y1 <- sb_y + 0.75

# Spatial Domain section (same as master)
sb_y <- sb_add_section(
  "Spatial Domain",
  names(annot_cols),
  annot_cols, 18, sb_y
)
sb_sep_y2 <- sb_y + 0.75

# Boundary section — only BCZ <-> Treg_Zone
sb_bnd_name <- "B_Cell_Zone <-> Treg_Zone"
sb_bnd_col <- boundary_pair_cols[sb_bnd_name]
sb_y <- sb_add_section(
  "Boundary",
  sb_bnd_name,
  sb_bnd_col, 15, sb_y
)

sb_legend_df <- do.call(rbind, sb_rows)
sb_entry_df <- sb_legend_df[!sb_legend_df$is_title, ]
sb_title_df <- sb_legend_df[sb_legend_df$is_title, ]

p_sb_legend <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = sb_entry_df,
    aes(x = 0, y = y),
    color = sb_entry_df$color,
    shape = sb_entry_df$shape_num,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sb_entry_df,
    aes(x = 0.4, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = 1.8,
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = sb_title_df,
    aes(x = 0, y = y, label = label),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.2,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = data.frame(
      y = c(sb_sep_y1, sb_sep_y2)
    ),
    aes(
      x = -0.2, xend = 12,
      y = y, yend = y
    ),
    linewidth = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 12),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2)
  )

print(p_sb_legend)

sb_n_rows <- nrow(sb_legend_df)
sb_legend_h <- max(1.5, sb_n_rows * 0.1 + 0.2)
ggsave(
  file.path(
    sandbox_boundary_dir,
    "Sandbox_Legend.png"
  ),
  p_sb_legend,
  width = 3.5, height = sb_legend_h,
  dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
message("\u2713 Saved Sandbox_Legend.png")

message("\n=== Section 7.11 Sandbox complete ===")
```

## 7.12 Figure Panel Assembly

Regenerate key panels with standardized fonts and dimensions for assembly into
a single 8.5" x 11" Illustrator figure. This chunk is self-contained: only
`combined_spe` must be loaded beforehand (via chunks `Environement setup`,
`global_parameters`, and `load_section7_data`).

``` {r figure_panel_assembly, fig.width=7.5, fig.height=4}
message("\n=== Section 7.12: Figure Panel Assembly ===")

# ── Packages ──
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)

library(SpatialExperiment)

# ── Output directory ──
figure_dir <- file.path(RES_DIR, "Figure_Panels")
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
message("Output: ", figure_dir)

# ── Color schemes (self-contained) ──
annot_cols <- c(
  "B_Cell_Zone"           = "#4A90B8",
  "Treg_Zone"             = "#8B008B",
  "T_Cell_Zone"           = "#D2691E",
  "Th2_T_Cell_Zone"       = "#2E8B57",
  "Resting_Lymphoid_Zone" = "#D9D9D9",
  "Low_Intensity_Zone"    = "#BDBDBD"
)
boundary_pair_cols <- c(
  "B_Cell_Zone <-> Treg_Zone" = "#FF0000"
)
bcell_cols <- c(
  "B Cells"            = "#00008B",
  "Activated B Cells"  = "#4169E1",

)
cond_cols_full <- c(
  "CAR-Treg"  = "#377eb8",
  "EGFR-Treg" = "#e41a1c"
)
cond_cols <- c(
  "CAR"  = "#377eb8",
  "EGFR" = "#e41a1c"
)

# ── Display name cleanup: replace underscores with spaces ──
names(annot_cols) <- gsub("_", " ", names(annot_cols))
names(boundary_pair_cols) <- gsub("_", " ", names(boundary_pair_cols))

# ── Condition column guard ──
if (!"condition" %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe))) {
  combined_spe$condition <- factor(ifelse(
    grepl("CAR", combined_spe$imageID), "CAR", "EGFR"
  ))
}

# ── Display-friendly labels: underscores → spaces ──
combined_spe$annotation <- gsub("_", " ", combined_spe$annotation)
combined_spe$imageID <- gsub("_", " ", combined_spe$imageID)

# ── Marker lookup ──
fig_markers <- c(
  PDL1  = grep("PDL1|CD274", rownames(combined_spe),
               ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1],
  MHCII = grep("IA-IE", rownames(combined_spe),
               ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1],
  CD40  = grep("CD40", rownames(combined_spe),
               ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)[1]
)
message("Markers: ",
        paste(names(fig_markers), fig_markers, sep = "=", collapse = ", "))

# ── Load boundary data from cache ──
boundary_qs <- file.path(
  RES_DIR, "SpatialDomains", "Boundaries",
  "boundary_results_voronoi.qs"
)
message("Loading boundary results: ", boundary_qs)
boundary_results <- qs::qread(boundary_qs)

# Apply min-area patch filter (matching line 4910-4914)
min_area <- 10000
valid_patches <- boundary_results$raw_patches %>%
  filter(total_area >= min_area) %>%
  pull(patch_id)
boundary_results$raw_edges <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
  filter(patch1 %in% valid_patches & patch2 %in% valid_patches)

# Derive boundary dependencies
boundary_stats <- boundary_results$stats
patch_perimeters <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(patch1, patch2),
    values_to = "patch_id", names_to = "patch_side"
  ) %>%
  group_by(imageID, patch_id) %>%
  summarise(total_perimeter = sum(length), .groups = "drop")
min_pct_perimeter <- 10

# ── Standardized theme ──
# All panels share identical font sizes (pt) for Illustrator consistency
LABEL_SIZE <- 3.0  # mm (~8.5pt) for geom_text

theme_figure <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) %+replace%
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0,
                                      margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.title       = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 10),
      legend.title     = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text      = element_text(size = 11),
      strip.text       = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
      plot.margin      = margin(4, 4, 4, 4, "pt")
    )
}

# ── Helper: B cell diff heatmap ──
build_figure_heatmap <- function(spe_obj, scope_label, markers,
                                 cell_masks, scale_limit = NULL) {
  delta_rows <- list()
  for (pop_name in names(cell_masks)) {
    mask <- cell_masks[[pop_name]]
    if (sum(mask) == 0) next
    spe_ct <- spe_obj[unname(markers), mask]
    expr_mat <- as.matrix(assay(spe_ct, "norm"))
    rownames(expr_mat) <- names(markers)
    cond <- spe_ct$condition
    car_cols <- which(cond == "CAR")
    egfr_cols <- which(cond == "EGFR")
    if (length(car_cols) == 0 || length(egfr_cols) == 0) next
    delta_rows[[pop_name]] <- data.frame(
      cellType = pop_name,
      marker = names(markers),
      delta = rowMeans(expr_mat[, egfr_cols, drop = FALSE]) -
        rowMeans(expr_mat[, car_cols, drop = FALSE]),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  if (length(delta_rows) == 0) return(NULL)

  delta_df <- do.call(rbind, delta_rows)
  delta_df$marker <- factor(delta_df$marker, levels = names(markers))
  delta_df$cellType <- factor(delta_df$cellType, levels = names(cell_masks))

  lim <- if (!is.null(scale_limit)) scale_limit else {
    max(abs(delta_df$delta), na.rm = TRUE)
  }

  # Breaks: 5 evenly spaced values with EGFR/CAR endpoint labels
  brk_vals <- c(lim, lim / 2, 0, -lim / 2, -lim)
  brk_labs <- c(
    paste0("EGFR\n", sprintf("%.2f", lim)),
    sprintf("%.2f", lim / 2),
    "0",
    sprintf("%.2f", -lim / 2),
    paste0(sprintf("%.2f", -lim), "\nCAR")
  )

  ggplot(delta_df, aes(x = cellType, y = marker, fill = delta)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(
      low = "#377eb8", mid = "white", high = "#e41a1c",
      midpoint = 0, limits = c(-lim, lim),
      breaks = brk_vals,
      labels = brk_labs,
      guide = guide_colorbar(
        title = NULL,
        barheight = unit(2.5, "cm"),
        barwidth = unit(0.2, "cm")
      )
    ) +
    labs(title = scope_label, x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_figure() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(40, 10, 40, 10, "pt"),
      aspect.ratio = 3 / 2
    )
}

# ── Panel 2: BCZ Composition Bar ──
bcz_spe <- combined_spe[, combined_spe$annotation == "B Cell Zone"]

prop_grouped <- as.data.frame(colData(bcz_spe)) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_group = case_when(
      cellType == "B Cells"            ~ "B Cells",
      cellType == "Activated B Cells"  ~ "Activated B Cells",
      TRUE                             ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition, cell_group) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n) * 100)

prop_grouped <- prop_grouped %>%
  arrange(condition, desc(cell_group)) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(
    ymax = cumsum(pct / 100),
    ymin = ymax - pct / 100,
    ymid = (ymin + ymax) / 2,
    label = paste0(round(pct, 1), "%"),
    text_col = ifelse(cell_group == "Other", "black", "white")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

p_stack <- ggplot(
  prop_grouped,
  aes(x = condition, y = pct / 100, fill = cell_group)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.5) +

# ── Panel 5: Boundary Metrics Bar ──
fig_has_stats <- !is.null(boundary_stats) && nrow(boundary_stats) > 0
fig_has_raw_edges <- !is.null(boundary_results$raw_edges) &&
  "patch1" %in% colnames(boundary_results$raw_edges)

if (fig_has_stats && fig_has_raw_edges) {
  # Shared boundary length
  target_int <- boundary_stats %>%
    filter(
      (source_domain == bp_d1 & target_domain == bp_d2) |
      (source_domain == bp_d2 & target_domain == bp_d1)
    )
  boundary_abs <- target_int %>%
    filter(source_domain == bp_d1) %>%
    select(imageID, value = shared_length)

  # Micro-boundary count (all patch-pair interfaces, no filter)
  focus_micro <- boundary_results$raw_edges %>%
    filter(
      (domain1 == bp_d1 & domain2 == bp_d2) |
      (domain1 == bp_d2 & domain2 == bp_d1)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      patch_a = ifelse(domain1 == bp_d1, patch1, patch2),
      patch_b = ifelse(domain1 == bp_d2, patch1, patch2)
    ) %>%
    group_by(imageID, patch_a, patch_b) %>%
    summarise(
      interface_length = sum(length), .groups = "drop"
    )

  interaction_counts <- focus_micro %>%
    group_by(imageID) %>%
    summarise(interaction_count = n(), .groups = "drop")

  focus_data <- bind_rows(
    boundary_abs %>%
      mutate(metric = "Shared Boundary Length"),
    interaction_counts %>%
      select(imageID, value = interaction_count) %>%
      mutate(metric = "Micro-Boundary Count")
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      condition = ifelse(
        grepl("CAR", imageID), "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(metric) %>%
    mutate(normalized = value / max(value)) %>%
    ungroup()

  focus_summary <- focus_data %>%
    group_by(metric, condition) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_norm = mean(normalized),
      mean_raw  = mean(value),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      label = ifelse(
        grepl("Length", metric),
        paste0(round(mean_raw / 1000, 0), "K"),
        as.character(round(mean_raw, 0))
      ),
      pair_label = "B Cell Zone / Treg Zone"
    )

  p_metrics <- ggplot(
    focus_summary,
    aes(y = pair_label, x = mean_raw, fill = condition)
  ) +
    geom_col(
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
      width = 0.6
    ) +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = label),
      position = position_dodge(width = 0.7),
      hjust = -0.1, size = LABEL_SIZE, fontface = "bold"
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = cond_cols_full,
      name = NULL
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))) +
    labs(
      title = "Boundary Metrics: B Cell Zone / Treg Zone",
      x = NULL, y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_figure() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "left"
    )

  ggsave(
    file.path(figure_dir, "boundary_metrics_BCZ_TregZ_figure.png"),
    p_metrics,
    width = 7.5, height = 1.5, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
  )
  message("\u2713 boundary_metrics_BCZ_TregZ_figure.png")
} else {
  message("\u26a0 Boundary metrics skipped — stats or raw edges unavailable")
}

message("\n=== Section 7.12 complete ===")
message("Figure panels saved to: ", figure_dir)
```

``` {r supp_density_violin, fig.width=6, fig.height=3}
message("\n--- Supp Panel 3/3: B Cell Zone Density Violin ---")

# ── Packages (inherited from 7.12 chunk above) ──
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(SpatialExperiment)

stopifnot(
  "boundary_results$cell_patches missing — re-run section 7.10 with updated spatial_domain_analysis.R" =
    !is.null(boundary_results$cell_patches)
)

# Pixel size from segmentation pipeline params (CAR_TREG_2_pipeline_params.json)
# 1 px = 0.182 µm  →  1 px² = 0.182² µm²
# Density expressed as cells / 100 µm² for human-readable values (~1–10 range)
um_per_px   <- 0.182
area_scale  <- um_per_px^2   # µm² per px²
density_per <- 100            # report as cells per N µm²

# ── 1. Build per-cell data frame ──
# boundary_results uses underscored imageIDs; combined_spe$imageID was transformed
# to space-form at line 6808, so normalize before joining
cp <- boundary_results$cell_patches
cp$imageID_disp <- gsub("_", " ", cp$imageID)

coords_df <- data.frame(
  imageID  = as.character(combined_spe$imageID),
  x        = spatialCoords(combined_spe)[, "x"],
  y        = spatialCoords(combined_spe)[, "y"],
  cellType  = combined_spe$cellType,
  condition = as.character(combined_spe$condition),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

coords_df <- coords_df %>%
  left_join(
    cp %>% select(imageID_disp, x, y, patch_id, domain_raw = domain),
    by = c("imageID" = "imageID_disp", "x", "y")
  )

# ── 2. B Cell Zone patches passing the min_area filter ──
bcz_patches <- boundary_results$raw_patches %>%
  filter(domain == "B_Cell_Zone", total_area >= min_area) %>%
  select(imageID, patch_id, total_area) %>%
  mutate(imageID_disp = gsub("_", " ", imageID))

message("  B Cell Zone patches after min_area filter: ", nrow(bcz_patches))

# ── 3. Per-(patch × cell_group) density ──
cell_groups <- list(
  "All cells"         = function(ct) rep(TRUE, length(ct)),
  "Activated B Cells" = function(ct) ct == "Activated B Cells",
  "B Cells"           = function(ct) ct == "B Cells"
)

density_rows <- list()
for (grp_name in names(cell_groups)) {
  grp_mask <- cell_groups[[grp_name]](coords_df$cellType)

  counts <- coords_df %>%
    filter(grp_mask) %>%
    inner_join(bcz_patches,
               by = c("imageID" = "imageID_disp", "patch_id")) %>%
    group_by(imageID, patch_id, total_area) %>%
    summarise(n_cells = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(
      density    = n_cells * density_per / (total_area * area_scale),
      cell_group = grp_name,
      condition  = if_else(grepl("CAR", imageID), "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg")
    )

  # Patches with zero cells of this group contribute density = 0
  # Use if_else (type-safe) so condition stays character even when anti_join
  # returns 0 rows and base ifelse would silently return logical(0)
  zero_patches <- bcz_patches %>%
    anti_join(counts, by = c("imageID_disp" = "imageID", "patch_id")) %>%
    mutate(
      n_cells    = 0L,
      density    = 0,
      cell_group = grp_name,
      condition  = if_else(grepl("CAR", imageID_disp), "CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg")
    ) %>%
    select(imageID = imageID_disp, patch_id, total_area,
           n_cells, density, cell_group, condition)

  density_rows[[grp_name]] <- bind_rows(counts, zero_patches)
}

density_df <- bind_rows(density_rows) %>%
  mutate(cell_group = factor(
    cell_group,
    levels = c("All cells", "Activated B Cells", "B Cells")
  ))

# ── 4. Wilcoxon rank-sum test per cell group ──
# Non-parametric: density values are right-skewed; n patches >> 30 so exact = FALSE
wilcox_results <- density_df %>%
  group_by(cell_group) %>%
  summarise(
    n_car  = sum(condition == "CAR-Treg"),
    n_egfr = sum(condition == "EGFR-Treg"),
    p_val  = wilcox.test(
      density[condition == "CAR-Treg"],
      density[condition == "EGFR-Treg"],
      exact = FALSE
    )$p.value,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sig_label = dplyr::case_when(
      p_val < 0.0001 ~ "****",
      p_val < 0.001  ~ "***",
      p_val < 0.01   ~ "**",
      p_val < 0.05   ~ "*",
      TRUE           ~ "ns"
    )
  )

message("\n  Wilcoxon rank-sum (CAR vs EGFR per B Cell Zone patch density):")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(wilcox_results))) {
  message(sprintf("    %-20s  n_CAR=%-4d n_EGFR=%-4d  p=%.4g  %s",
    wilcox_results$cell_group[i],
    wilcox_results$n_car[i],
    wilcox_results$n_egfr[i],
    wilcox_results$p_val[i],
    wilcox_results$sig_label[i]))
}

# ── 5. Violin + jittered points per cell group ──
p_density <- ggplot(
    density_df,
    aes(x = condition, y = density, fill = condition)
  ) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.55, color = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    aes(color = condition),
    width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  ggsignif::geom_signif(
    comparisons  = list(c("CAR-Treg", "EGFR-Treg")),
    test         = "wilcox.test",
    test.args    = list(exact = FALSE),
    map_signif_level = TRUE,
    tip_length   = 0.02,
    textsize     = 3.5,
    vjust        = 0.3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ cell_group, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = cond_cols_full, guide = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cond_cols_full, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.20))) +
  labs(
    title    = "B Cell Zone Density",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Each point = one B Cell Zone patch (≥ ",
      format(min_area, big.mark = ","), " area units); Wilcoxon rank-sum"
    ),
    x = NULL, y = paste0("Cells per ", density_per, " µm²")
  ) +
  theme_figure() +
  theme(
    plot.title    = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", hjust = 0,
                                 margin = margin(b = 6)),
    strip.text    = element_text(size = 9,  face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x   = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.spacing = unit(0.6, "lines")
  )

ggsave(
  file.path(figure_dir, "density_violin_BCZ_figure.png"),
  p_density,
  width = 6.0, height = 3.0, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
message("✓ density_violin_BCZ_figure.png")
```

# 8. Changes in Marker Expression (SpatioMark)

Sometimes, cells that appear similar based on marker expression alone can behave very differently depending on their surroundings. Subtle shifts in marker levels—too faint or variable to be captured through clustering—may hold important clues about a cell's functional state. For example, immune cells may only become activated when positioned near tumor cells, and these changes may not be detectable when cells are analyzed in isolation.

The **SpatioMark** method, implemented in the **Statial** package, detects markers whose expression levels change within a given cell type depending on their spatial context—highlighting activation, suppression, or other state changes that are missed by standard clustering.

## 8.0 Optional: Load Data from Previous Section

If you've already completed Section 7 and want to resume from here, you can load the saved data object.

``` {r load_section7_data, eval=FALSE}
# Uncomment and run this chunk to load data from end of Section 7
checkpoint_dir <- file.path(PROG_DIR, "Checkpoints")
combined_spe <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, paste0("combined_spe_after_section7", CHECKPOINT_SUFFIX, ".rds")))
message("✓ Loaded data from end of Section 7")
```

## 8.1 Marker Means by Cell Type and Region

Before examining continuous spatial changes, we can summarize marker expression by cell type and spatial region. This reveals how marker expression varies across tissue compartments (e.g., germinal centers vs T zones).

``` {r calculate_marker_means}
message("Calculating marker means by cell type and region...")

# Create Marker Expression output directory
marker_expr_dir <- file.path(RES_DIR, "MarkerExpression")
dir.create(marker_expr_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
message("✓ Output directory: ", marker_expr_dir)

# Calculate marker means for cell type × region combinations
cellTypeRegionMeans <- Statial::getMarkerMeans(
  combined_spe,
  imageID = "imageID",
  cellType = "cellType",
  region = "region" # Uses regions from lisaClust (Section 7)
)

message("\n✓ Marker means calculated")
message(
  "  Dimensions: ", nrow(cellTypeRegionMeans), " images × ",
  ncol(cellTypeRegionMeans), " features"
)

# Export cell type × region means
celltype_region_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "marker_means_celltype_region.csv")
write.csv(cellTypeRegionMeans, celltype_region_file, row.names = TRUE)
message("✓ Cell type × region means saved to: ", basename(celltype_region_file))

# Show first few columns
message("\nExample features (first 5):")
print(head(colnames(cellTypeRegionMeans), 5))
print(head(cellTypeRegionMeans[, 1:5], 2))

# Also calculate means by cell type alone (without region)
cellTypeMeans <- Statial::getMarkerMeans(
  combined_spe,
  imageID = "imageID",
  cellType = "cellType"
)

message("\nCell type means (without regions):")
message(
  "  Dimensions: ", nrow(cellTypeMeans), " images × ",
  ncol(cellTypeMeans), " features"
)

# Export cell type means
celltype_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "marker_means_celltype_only.csv")
write.csv(cellTypeMeans, celltype_file, row.names = TRUE)
message("✓ Cell type means saved to: ", basename(celltype_file))
```

**What are marker means?**
- Average marker intensity for each cell type in each spatial region
- Column names formatted as: `marker__cellType__region`
- Useful for identifying cell states specific to spatial contexts
- Example: CD4 expression in T cells may differ between germinal centers vs T zones

``` {r compare_marker_means_between_images, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
message("\nComparing marker means between images...")

# Get all feature names
all_features <- colnames(cellTypeRegionMeans)

message("Total features: ", length(all_features))

# Convert to long format for comparison
celltype_region_long <- cellTypeRegionMeans %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("imageID") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -imageID, names_to = "feature", values_to = "mean_intensity")

# Split feature names to extract components
# Use extra = "merge" to keep additional underscores in the marker name
feature_components <- celltype_region_long %>%
  tidyr::separate(feature,
    into = c("marker", "cellType", "region"),
    sep = "__", remove = FALSE, extra = "merge"
  )

# Get image names
image_names <- unique(feature_components$imageID)
message("Images found: ", paste(image_names, collapse = ", "))

# Compare between images
marker_means_comparison <- feature_components %>%
  select(imageID, marker, cellType, region, mean_intensity) %>%
  # Group to handle any potential duplicates
  group_by(marker, cellType, region, imageID) %>%
  summarise(mean_intensity = mean(mean_intensity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = imageID, values_from = mean_intensity) %>%
  mutate(
    difference = .data[[image_names[2]]] - .data[[image_names[1]]], # Image2 - Image1
    abs_difference = abs(difference),
    fold_change = .data[[image_names[2]]] / (.data[[image_names[1]]] + 1e-10) # Avoid division by zero
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs_difference))

message("\nTop 20 largest marker expression differences:")
message("  (These may represent functional state changes between images)")
print(head(marker_means_comparison, 20))

# Export full comparison
marker_comp_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "marker_means_comparison_between_images.csv")
write.csv(marker_means_comparison, marker_comp_file, row.names = FALSE)
message("\n✓ Full marker means comparison saved to: ", basename(marker_comp_file))

# Visualize top differences
top_20_diffs <- head(marker_means_comparison, 20)

# Create better labels
top_20_diffs$label <- paste0(
  top_20_diffs$marker, " | ",
  top_20_diffs$cellType, " | ",
  top_20_diffs$region
)

diff_plot <- ggplot(top_20_diffs, aes(x = reorder(label, abs_difference), y = difference)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = difference > 0), width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("TRUE" = "coral", "FALSE" = "steelblue"),
    labels = c("TRUE" = "Higher in Image 2", "FALSE" = "Higher in Image 1")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 20 Marker Expression Differences Between Images",
    subtitle = "Marker | Cell Type | Spatial Domain",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Difference in Mean Expression (Image 2 - Image 1)",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

print(diff_plot)

# Save
diff_plot_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "marker_means_top_differences.png")
ggsave(diff_plot_file, plot = diff_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
message("✓ Top differences plot saved to: ", basename(diff_plot_file))

message("\n💡 Biological Interpretation for Spleen:")
message("  • Look for activation markers (CD69, CD25, etc.) showing regional differences")
message("  • Check if exhaustion markers (PD1, CTLA-4) differ in GC vs T zones")
message("  • Examine cytokine expression (IL-10, IFNγ, IL-21) in different compartments")
```

## 8.2 SpatioMark: Continuous Cell State Changes

SpatioMark captures how marker expression changes based on proximity to other cell types, revealing context-dependent expression shifts.

### 8.2.1 Calculate Spatial Metrics

First, we calculate spatial proximity and abundance for each cell.

``` {r calculate_spatial_metrics}
message("Calculating spatial metrics for SpatioMark...")

# Ensure spatial coordinates are in colData
if (!all(c("x", "y") %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe)))) {
  message("  Adding spatial coordinates to colData...")
  colData(combined_spe)$x <- spatialCoords(combined_spe)[, "x"]
  colData(combined_spe)$y <- spatialCoords(combined_spe)[, "y"]
}

# Calculate distances to nearest cell of each type
# maxDist = maximum distance to consider (in pixels)
message("\n  Calculating distances (maxDist = 200 pixels)...")
combined_spe <- Statial::getDistances(
  combined_spe,
  maxDist = 200,
  nCores = nCores
)

# Calculate K-function (local abundance) for each cell type
# r = radius for K-function calculation
message("  Calculating abundances (r = 200 pixels)...")
combined_spe <- Statial::getAbundances(
  combined_spe,
  r = 200,
  nCores = nCores
)

message("\n✓ Spatial metrics calculated")
message("  reducedDims now contains:")
print(names(reducedDims(combined_spe)))
```

### 8.2.2 Single Image Example: Cell State Changes

Let's examine a specific cell type pair in one image to understand the method.

``` {r spatiomark_single_example, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
message("Example: Analyzing cell state changes for one relationship...")

# Select an example image
example_image <- unique(combined_spe$imageID)[1]

# Select two cell types with sufficient cells
cell_type_counts <- table(combined_spe$cellType[combined_spe$imageID == example_image])
abundant_types <- names(head(sort(cell_type_counts, decreasing = TRUE), 5))

message("\nImage: ", example_image)
message("Most abundant cell types:")
print(head(sort(cell_type_counts, decreasing = TRUE), 5))

if (length(abundant_types) >= 2) {
  example_from <- abundant_types[1]
  example_to <- abundant_types[2]

  # Get available markers (exclude DNA markers)
  all_markers <- rownames(combined_spe)
  dna_markers <- grep("DNA|Hoechst", all_markers, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  available_markers <- setdiff(all_markers, dna_markers)
  example_marker <- available_markers[1]

  message("\nAnalyzing:")
  message("  From: ", example_from)
  message("  To: ", example_to)
  message("  Marker: ", example_marker)

  # Calculate state change for this specific relationship
  state_change_example <- tryCatch(
    {
      Statial::calcStateChanges(
        cells = combined_spe,
        type = "distances",
        image = example_image,
        from = example_from,
        to = example_to,
        marker = example_marker,
        nCores = 1
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("  ⚠️  Error in calcStateChanges: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(state_change_example)) {
    message("\n✓ State change result:")
    print(state_change_example)

    message("\nInterpretation:")
    if (state_change_example$coef < 0) {
      message(
        "  • Negative coefficient: ", example_marker, " decreases as distance from ",
        example_to, " increases"
      )
      message(
        "  • ", example_from, " cells express MORE ", example_marker, " when CLOSE to ",
        example_to
      )
    } else {
      message(
        "  • Positive coefficient: ", example_marker, " increases as distance from ",
        example_to, " increases"
      )
      message(
        "  • ", example_from, " cells express LESS ", example_marker, " when CLOSE to ",
        example_to
      )
    }

    # Visualize the relationship
    message("\nGenerating visualization...")

    # Check if marker exists in the normalized assay
    if (example_marker %in% rownames(combined_spe)) {
      state_plot <- tryCatch(
        {
          Statial::plotStateChanges(
            cells = combined_spe,
            type = "distances",
            image = example_image,
            from = example_from,
            to = example_to,
            marker = example_marker,
            size = 1,
            shape = 19,
            interactive = FALSE,
            plotModelFit = FALSE,
            method = "lm"
          )
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message("  ⚠️  Error in plotStateChanges: ", e$message)
          message("  (This is expected - plotting may not work with normalized data)")
          return(NULL)
        }
      )
    } else {
      message("  ⚠️  Marker not found in rownames, skipping visualization")
      message("  (Results table above is still valid)")
      state_plot <- NULL
    }

    if (!is.null(state_plot)) {
      # Display spatial plot
      print(state_plot$image +
        labs(
          title = paste("Spatial Distribution:", example_image),
          subtitle = paste(example_from, "colored by", example_marker, "expression")
        ))

      # Display scatter plot
      print(state_plot$scatter +
        labs(
          title = paste("State Change:", example_marker, "in", example_from),
          subtitle = paste("As distance from", example_to, "increases")
        ))

      # Save
      spatial_file <- file.path(
        marker_expr_dir,
        paste0("spatiomark_example_spatial_", example_image, ".png")
      )
      ggsave(spatial_file, plot = state_plot$image, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

      scatter_file <- file.path(
        marker_expr_dir,
        paste0("spatiomark_example_scatter_", example_image, ".png")
      )
      ggsave(scatter_file, plot = state_plot$scatter, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

      message("\n✓ Plots saved to QC_plots/")
    }
  }
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  Need at least 2 abundant cell types for demonstration")
}
```

### 8.2.3 Comprehensive Analysis: All Cell Type Pairs

Now let's identify the most significant spatial marker changes across all cell type pairs.

``` {r spatiomark_comprehensive}
message("Analyzing all cell type pairs for spatial marker changes...")
message("Note: This analyzes each image separately (no cross-image statistics with n=2)")

# Calculate state changes for all relationships
# minCells = minimum cells required for analysis
stateChanges_all <- tryCatch(
  {
    Statial::calcStateChanges(
      cells = combined_spe,
      type = "distances",
      nCores = nCores,
      minCells = 50 # Require at least 50 cells
    )
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("  ⚠️  Error in calcStateChanges: ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  }
)

if (!is.null(stateChanges_all)) {
  message("\n✓ State changes calculated")
  message("  Total relationships tested: ", nrow(stateChanges_all))

  # Show top results for each image
  for (img_id in unique(combined_spe$imageID)) {
    message("\n", img_id, " - Top 10 most significant changes:")

    img_results <- stateChanges_all %>%
      filter(imageID == img_id) %>%
      arrange(pval) %>%
      head(10)

    print(img_results %>% select(primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, coef, pval))
  }

  # Visualize a few top results
  message("\nVisualizing top 3 relationships for each image...")

  for (img_id in unique(combined_spe$imageID)) {
    img_top <- stateChanges_all %>%
      filter(imageID == img_id) %>%
      arrange(pval) %>%
      head(3)

    for (i in 1:min(nrow(img_top), 3)) {
      row <- img_top[i, ]

      message(
        "\n  ", img_id, " - Rank ", i, ": ",
        row$primaryCellType, " → ", row$otherCellType, " (", row$marker, ")"
      )

      p <- tryCatch(
        {
          Statial::plotStateChanges(
            cells = combined_spe,
            type = "distances",
            image = as.character(row$imageID),
            from = row$primaryCellType,
            to = row$otherCellType,
            marker = row$marker,
            size = 0.5,
            shape = 19,
            interactive = FALSE,
            plotModelFit = TRUE,
            method = "lm"
          )
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message("    ⚠️  Could not plot: ", e$message)
          return(NULL)
        }
      )

      if (!is.null(p)) {
        print(p$scatter +
          labs(
            title = paste(img_id, ":", row$marker, "in", row$primaryCellType),
            subtitle = paste(
              "Distance from", row$otherCellType,
              "| coef =", round(row$coef, 4),
              "| p =", format(row$pval, scientific = TRUE, digits = 2)
            )
          ))
      }
    }
  }
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  Could not calculate comprehensive state changes")
}
```

### 8.2.4 Contamination Detection

Lateral marker spillover can create false relationships. `calcContamination` predicts the probability each cell is its assigned type.

``` {r calculate_contamination}
message("Calculating contamination probabilities...")
message("Note: This identifies cells that may be misclassified due to spillover")

combined_spe <- tryCatch(
  {
    Statial::calcContamination(combined_spe)
  },
  error = function(e) {
    message("  ⚠️  Error in calcContamination: ", e$message)
    return(combined_spe)
  }
)

# Check if contamination was calculated
if ("contaminations" %in% names(reducedDims(combined_spe))) {
  message("\n✓ Contamination probabilities calculated")

  # Extract contamination probabilities
  contam_probs <- reducedDims(combined_spe)$contaminations

  if ("rfMainCellProb" %in% colnames(contam_probs)) {
    # Show distribution of probabilities
    main_prob <- contam_probs[, "rfMainCellProb"]

    message("\nDistribution of cell type assignment confidence:")
    message("  Mean: ", round(mean(main_prob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
    message("  Median: ", round(median(main_prob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
    message("  Min: ", round(min(main_prob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
    message("  Max: ", round(max(main_prob, na.rm = TRUE), 3))

    # Count low-confidence cells
    low_conf <- sum(main_prob < 0.7, na.rm = TRUE)
    message(
      "\nLow confidence cells (< 70%): ", low_conf, " (",
      round(100 * low_conf / length(main_prob), 1), "%)"
    )

    # Plot distribution
    prob_df <- data.frame(
      probability = main_prob,
      cellType = combined_spe$cellType,
      imageID = combined_spe$imageID
    )

    prob_plot <- ggplot(prob_df, aes(x = probability)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
      facet_wrap(~imageID, ncol = 1) +
      labs(
        title = "Cell Type Assignment Confidence",
        subtitle = "Probability that each cell is correctly classified",
        x = "Probability (rfMainCellProb)",
        y = "Number of Cells"
      ) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0.7, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
      theme_classic()

    print(prob_plot)

    # Save
    prob_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "contamination_probabilities.png")
    ggsave(prob_file, plot = prob_plot, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

    message("\n✓ Contamination plot saved to: ", basename(prob_file))

    message("\nInterpretation:")
    message("  • High probability (>0.8): Cell is confidently its assigned type")
    message("  • Medium (0.5-0.8): Some uncertainty, possible spillover")
    message("  • Low (<0.5): High uncertainty, likely contamination")
  }
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  Contamination not calculated - continuing without correction")
}
```

### 8.2.5 Corrected State Changes (Accounting for Contamination)

Re-run state change analysis with contamination correction.

``` {r spatiomark_corrected, eval=FALSE}
# Only run if contamination was successfully calculated
if ("contaminations" %in% names(reducedDims(combined_spe))) {
  message("Re-calculating state changes with contamination correction...")

  stateChanges_corrected <- tryCatch(
    {
      Statial::calcStateChanges(
        cells = combined_spe,
        type = "distances",
        nCores = 1, # Serial for stability
        minCells = 50,
        contamination = TRUE # Include contamination probabilities as covariates
      )
    },
    error = function(e) {
      message("  ⚠️  Error in corrected calcStateChanges: ", e$message)
      return(NULL)
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(stateChanges_corrected)) {
    message("\n✓ Corrected state changes calculated")

    # Compare top results before and after correction
    message("\nComparison: Top 10 results")
    message("\nBefore correction:")
    print(head(stateChanges_all %>% arrange(pval) %>%
      select(imageID, primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, pval), 10))

    message("\nAfter correction:")
    print(head(stateChanges_corrected %>% arrange(pval) %>%
      select(imageID, primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, pval), 10))

    message("\n✓ Contamination correction may remove false positive relationships")
    message("  Particularly those involving cell type-specific markers")
  }
}
```

## 8.3 Compare State Changes Between Images

With 2 images, we can compare spatial relationships to identify treatment/condition-specific marker changes.

``` {r compare_state_changes, fig.width=14, fig.height=10}
if (!is.null(stateChanges_all)) {
  message("Comparing state changes between images...")

  # Export full state changes results
  state_changes_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "spatiomark_state_changes_all.csv")
  write.csv(stateChanges_all, state_changes_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message("✓ Full state changes results saved to: ", basename(state_changes_file))

  # For each cell type pair and marker, compare coefficients between images
  state_comparison <- stateChanges_all %>%
    group_by(primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker) %>%
    filter(n() == 2) %>% # Only pairs found in both images
    summarise(
      imageID_1 = imageID[1],
      imageID_2 = imageID[2],
      coef_img1 = coef[1],
      coef_img2 = coef[2],
      pval_img1 = pval[1],
      pval_img2 = pval[2],
      diff = coef_img2 - coef_img1,
      abs_diff = abs(coef_img2 - coef_img1),
      sign_change = sign(coef_img1) != sign(coef_img2),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_diff))

  # Export comparison
  state_comp_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "spatiomark_state_changes_comparison.csv")
  write.csv(state_comparison, state_comp_file, row.names = FALSE)
  message("✓ State changes comparison saved to: ", basename(state_comp_file))

  message("\nTop 20 relationships with largest differences between images:")
  message("  (These may represent treatment/condition effects)")
  print(head(state_comparison, 20))

  # Identify sign changes (relationship flips)
  sign_changes <- state_comparison %>%
    filter(sign_change == TRUE) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_diff))

  if (nrow(sign_changes) > 0) {
    message("\n🔄 Relationships that FLIP direction between images:")
    message("  ", nrow(sign_changes), " relationships show sign changes")
    message("\nTop 10 sign changes:")
    print(head(sign_changes %>%
      select(primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, coef_img1, coef_img2, pval_img1, pval_img2), 10))

    # Export sign changes
    sign_change_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "spatiomark_sign_changes.csv")
    write.csv(sign_changes, sign_change_file, row.names = FALSE)
    message("✓ Sign changes saved to: ", basename(sign_change_file))
  } else {
    message("\n  No relationships with sign changes detected")
  }

  # Plot comparison
  if (nrow(state_comparison) > 0) {
    # Scatter plot
    comp_plot <- ggplot(
      state_comparison,
      aes(x = coef_img1, y = coef_img2)
    ) +
      geom_point(aes(
        size = -log10(pmin(pval_img1, pval_img2)),
        color = sign_change
      ), alpha = 0.6) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
      scale_color_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "red", "FALSE" = "steelblue"),
        labels = c("TRUE" = "Sign change", "FALSE" = "Same direction")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "SpatioMark State Changes: Image 1 vs Image 2",
        subtitle = "Points on diagonal = similar between images | Red = relationship flips direction",
        x = "Coefficient (Image 1)",
        y = "Coefficient (Image 2)",
        size = "-log10(p)",
        color = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
      )

    print(comp_plot)

    comp_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "spatiomark_state_changes_comparison_scatter.png")
    ggsave(comp_file, plot = comp_plot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    message("\n✓ Comparison scatter plot saved to: ", basename(comp_file))

    # Bar plot of top differences
    top_20_state <- head(state_comparison, 20)
    top_20_state$label <- paste0(
      top_20_state$marker, " in ", top_20_state$primaryCellType,
      " → ", top_20_state$otherCellType
    )

    bar_plot <- ggplot(top_20_state, aes(x = reorder(label, abs_diff), y = diff)) +
      geom_col(aes(fill = diff > 0), width = 0.7) +
      coord_flip() +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c("TRUE" = "coral", "FALSE" = "steelblue"),
        labels = c("TRUE" = "Stronger in Image 2", "FALSE" = "Stronger in Image 1")
      ) +
      labs(
        title = "Top 20 State Change Differences Between Images",
        subtitle = "Marker expression changes relative to proximity to other cell types",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Difference in Coefficient (Image 2 - Image 1)",
        fill = NULL
      ) +
      theme_classic() +
      theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.position = "top",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
      )

    print(bar_plot)

    bar_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "spatiomark_state_changes_top_differences.png")
    ggsave(bar_file, plot = bar_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
    message("✓ Top differences bar plot saved to: ", basename(bar_file))
  }

  message("\n💡 Biological Interpretation:")
  message("  • Negative coef: Marker INCREASES when cells are CLOSER together")
  message("  • Positive coef: Marker DECREASES when cells are CLOSER together")
  message("  • Sign changes may indicate different microenvironment effects")
  message("  • For spleen: Look for activation/exhaustion markers changing near B or T zones")
} else {
  message("⚠️  No state changes calculated - skipping comparison")
}
```

## 8.3.1 FoxP3+ Marker Expression Changes

**Do other markers change in FoxP3+ Tregs based on spatial context?**

``` {r foxp3_state_changes}
message("\n🔬 FOXP3+ TREG STATE CHANGES")

# Filter state changes for FoxP3+ cell types
if (exists("stateChanges_all") && !is.null(stateChanges_all) && nrow(stateChanges_all) > 0) {
  # Identify which clusters are FoxP3+
  if (exists("foxp3_by_cluster")) {
    foxp3_clusters <- foxp3_by_cluster %>%
      group_by(clusters) %>%
      summarise(mean_foxp3_pct = mean(foxp3_percentage), .groups = "drop") %>%
      filter(mean_foxp3_pct > 50) %>% # Clusters with >50% FoxP3+
      pull(clusters) %>%
      unique()

    message("FoxP3+ enriched clusters: ", paste(foxp3_clusters, collapse = ", "))

    if (length(foxp3_clusters) > 0) {
      # Filter for FoxP3+ clusters
      foxp3_state_changes <- stateChanges_all %>%
        filter(primaryCellType %in% foxp3_clusters)

      if (nrow(foxp3_state_changes) > 0) {
        message("\nTop 10 marker changes in FoxP3+ Tregs:")
        top_foxp3_state <- foxp3_state_changes %>%
          arrange(pval) %>%
          head(10) %>%
          select(imageID, primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, coef, pval)
        print(top_foxp3_state)

        # Export
        foxp3_state_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "FOXP3_state_changes.csv")
        write.csv(foxp3_state_changes, foxp3_state_file, row.names = FALSE)
        message("\n✓ FoxP3+ state changes saved to: ", basename(foxp3_state_file))

        # Compare FoxP3+ state changes between images (if 2 images)
        if (length(unique(foxp3_state_changes$imageID)) == 2) {
          image_ids <- unique(foxp3_state_changes$imageID)

          foxp3_state_comp <- foxp3_state_changes %>%
            select(primaryCellType, otherCellType, marker, imageID, coef) %>%
            tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = imageID, values_from = coef, names_prefix = "coef_") %>%
            mutate(
              difference = abs(.[[5]] - .[[4]]),
              sign_change = sign(.[[4]]) != sign(.[[5]])
            ) %>%
            arrange(desc(difference))

          message("\nTop 5 FoxP3+ Treg state change differences:")
          print(head(foxp3_state_comp, 5))

          # Export
          foxp3_state_comp_file <- file.path(marker_expr_dir, "FOXP3_state_changes_comparison.csv")
          write.csv(foxp3_state_comp, foxp3_state_comp_file, row.names = FALSE)
          message("✓ FoxP3+ state comparison saved to: ", basename(foxp3_state_comp_file))
        }

        message("\n🎯 KEY QUESTION: Do Treg activation/exhaustion markers change near other cells?")
        message("  Look for: PD1, CTLA-4, IL-10 proximity-dependent changes")
        message("  Negative coef = marker increases when cells are closer")
        message("  Positive coef = marker decreases when cells are closer")
      } else {
        message("⚠️  No state changes detected for FoxP3+ clusters")
      }
    } else {
      message("⚠️  No clusters with >50% FoxP3+ cells found")
    }
  } else {
    message("⚠️  foxp3_by_cluster not found")
  }
} else {
  message("⚠️  stateChanges_all not found, skipping FoxP3+ state change analysis")
}
```

# 9. Comprehensive Feature Summary & Comparison

In studies with many images and clinical outcomes, **ClassifyR** and **scFeatures** are used to build predictive models. With only 2 images, we cannot perform statistical classification, but we **can**:

1. Generate a comprehensive feature summary for future analysis
2. Compare features between the two images
3. Prepare the data structure for when more images are added

This section demonstrates the **framework** for feature-based analysis that becomes powerful with larger datasets.

## 9.0 Optional: Load Data from Previous Section

If you've already completed Section 8 and want to resume from here, you can load the saved data object.

``` {r load_section8_data, eval=FALSE}
# Uncomment and run this chunk to load data from end of Section 8
# checkpoint_dir <- file.path(PROG_DIR, "Checkpoints")
# combined_spe <- readRDS(file.path(checkpoint_dir, "combined_spe_after_section8.rds"))
# message("✓ Loaded data from end of Section 8")
```

## 9.1 Introduction to Feature-Based Analysis

**What are sample-level features?**

Instead of analyzing individual cells, we summarize each **image** (or patient) using aggregate features:
- Cell type proportions
- Spatial co-localization metrics
- Domain composition
- Marker expression summaries
- Cell state changes

**Why use features?**

- Enables comparison between images/patients
- Reduces dimensionality (millions of cells → dozens of features)
- Compatible with machine learning models
- Links spatial patterns to clinical outcomes

> **Note**: This framework is most powerful with **≥10 images** and clinical variables (survival, treatment response, disease progression)

## 9.2 Generate Comprehensive Feature Set

Let's consolidate all the spatial metrics we've calculated into a structured feature matrix.

``` {r generate_feature_matrices}
message("Generating comprehensive feature matrices...")

# Initialize feature list
feature_data <- list()

# 1. Cell Type Proportions (from clustering)
message("\n1. Cell type proportions...")
prop_df <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  group_by(imageID, cellType) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(imageID) %>%
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
  select(imageID, cellType, proportion) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = cellType, values_from = proportion, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("imageID")

feature_data[["proportions"]] <- as.matrix(prop_df)
message("  ✓ ", ncol(prop_df), " cell type proportions")

# 2. Spatial Domain Proportions (from lisaClust)
message("\n2. Spatial domain proportions...")
if ("region" %in% colnames(colData(combined_spe))) {
  domain_df <- colData(combined_spe) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    group_by(imageID, region) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(imageID) %>%
    mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>%
    select(imageID, region, proportion) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = proportion, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("imageID")

  feature_data[["spatial_domains"]] <- as.matrix(domain_df)
  message("  ✓ ", ncol(domain_df), " spatial domain proportions")
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  No spatial domains found (run Section 7 first)")
}

# 3. Cell Type Co-localization (from spicyR)
message("\n3. Co-localization metrics...")
if (exists("lfunction_df")) {
  # Use the L-function results from Section 5
  # lfunction_df is already in wide format with imageID and cell pair columns
  coloc_wide <- lfunction_df %>%
    select(-imageID) %>%
    as.matrix()

  rownames(coloc_wide) <- lfunction_df$imageID

  feature_data[["spicyR"]] <- coloc_wide
  message("  ✓ ", ncol(coloc_wide), " pairwise co-localization features")
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  No co-localization data found (run Section 5 first)")
}

# 4. Marker Means by Cell Type (from Section 8.1)
message("\n4. Marker means by cell type...")
if (exists("cellTypeMeans")) {
  feature_data[["cellTypeMarkerMeans"]] <- cellTypeMeans
  message("  ✓ ", ncol(cellTypeMeans), " marker-celltype combinations")
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  No marker means found (run Section 8.1 first)")
}

# 5. State Changes (from SpatioMark)
message("\n5. Spatial state changes...")
if (exists("stateChanges_all") && !is.null(stateChanges_all)) {
  state_wide <- stateChanges_all %>%
    mutate(feature = paste0(primaryCellType, "__", otherCellType, "__", marker)) %>%
    select(imageID, feature, coef) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = feature, values_from = coef, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("imageID")

  feature_data[["SpatioMark"]] <- as.matrix(state_wide)
  message("  ✓ ", ncol(state_wide), " state change features")
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  No state changes found (run Section 8.2 first)")
}

# 6. FoxP3+ Treg-Specific Features
message("\n6. FoxP3+ Treg features...")
if (exists("foxp3_summary") && exists("foxp3_by_cluster") && exists("foxp3_by_domain")) {
  # Create FoxP3 feature matrix
  foxp3_features <- data.frame(
    imageID = foxp3_summary$imageID,
    foxp3_percentage = foxp3_summary$foxp3_percentage,
    foxp3_mean_expression = foxp3_summary$mean_foxp3_expression,
    foxp3_median_expression = foxp3_summary$median_foxp3_expression
  )

  # Add FoxP3+ enrichment in top cluster per image
  top_clusters_per_image <- foxp3_by_cluster %>%
    group_by(imageID) %>%
    slice_max(foxp3_percentage, n = 1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(imageID, top_cluster_foxp3_pct = foxp3_percentage)

  foxp3_features <- foxp3_features %>%
    left_join(top_clusters_per_image, by = "imageID")

  # Add FoxP3+ enrichment in top spatial domain per image
  if (nrow(foxp3_by_domain) > 0) {
    top_domains_per_image <- foxp3_by_domain %>%
      group_by(imageID) %>%
      slice_max(foxp3_percentage, n = 1) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      select(imageID, top_domain_foxp3_pct = foxp3_percentage)

    foxp3_features <- foxp3_features %>%
      left_join(top_domains_per_image, by = "imageID")
  }

  foxp3_features <- foxp3_features %>%
    column_to_rownames("imageID") %>%
    as.matrix()

  feature_data[["FoxP3_Tregs"]] <- foxp3_features
  message("  ✓ ", ncol(foxp3_features), " FoxP3+ Treg features")
} else {
  message("  ⚠️  FoxP3 data not found (run Section 3.6.1 first)")
}

message("\n✓ Feature generation complete")
message("  Total feature types: ", length(feature_data))
message("  Total images: ", nrow(feature_data[[1]]))
```

## 9.3 Compare Features Between Images

With 2 images, we can perform a direct comparison of all features.

``` {r compare_all_features, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
message("Comparing all features between images...")

# Combine all features into one matrix
all_features <- do.call(cbind, feature_data)

message("\nTotal features: ", ncol(all_features))

# Calculate differences between images
if (nrow(all_features) == 2) {
  feature_diff <- data.frame(
    feature_name = colnames(all_features),
    feature_type = rep(names(feature_data), sapply(feature_data, ncol)),
    image1 = all_features[1, ],
    image2 = all_features[2, ],
    difference = all_features[2, ] - all_features[1, ],
    abs_difference = abs(all_features[2, ] - all_features[1, ]),
    fold_change = (all_features[2, ] + 0.0001) / (all_features[1, ] + 0.0001) # Add small constant
  )

  # Top 20 most different features
  message("\nTop 20 most different features:")
  top_diff <- feature_diff %>%
    arrange(desc(abs_difference)) %>%
    head(20)

  print(top_diff %>% select(feature_name, feature_type, image1, image2, difference))

  # Visualize top differences by feature type
  diff_plot <- ggplot(
    head(feature_diff %>% arrange(desc(abs_difference)), 30),
    aes(
      x = reorder(feature_name, abs_difference),
      y = difference,
      fill = feature_type
    )
  ) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Top 30 Features: Difference Between Images",
      subtitle = paste0(rownames(all_features)[1], " vs ", rownames(all_features)[2]),
      x = "Feature",
      y = "Difference (Image 2 - Image 1)",
      fill = "Feature Type"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))

  print(diff_plot)

  # Save
  diff_file <- file.path(qc_dir, "feature_differences_between_images.png")
  ggsave(diff_file, plot = diff_plot, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  message("\n✓ Feature comparison plot saved to: ", basename(diff_file))
}
```

## 9.4 Feature Type Comparison

Compare how different feature types distinguish between images.

``` {r feature_type_comparison, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
if (nrow(all_features) == 2 && exists("feature_diff")) {
  message("Comparing feature types...")

  # Summary by feature type
  type_summary <- feature_diff %>%
    group_by(feature_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_features = n(),
      mean_abs_diff = mean(abs_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_abs_diff = median(abs_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_abs_diff = max(abs_difference, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_abs_diff))

  message("\nFeature type summary:")
  print(type_summary)

  # Plot
  type_plot <- ggplot(type_summary, aes(
    x = reorder(feature_type, mean_abs_diff),
    y = mean_abs_diff
  )) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = feature_type), show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_features), hjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Feature Type Discriminatory Power",
      subtitle = "Which feature types differ most between images?",
      x = "Feature Type",
      y = "Mean Absolute Difference",
      caption = "Numbers show feature count per type"
    ) +
    theme_classic()

  print(type_plot)

  # Save
  type_file <- file.path(qc_dir, "feature_type_comparison.png")
  ggsave(type_file, plot = type_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

  message("\n✓ Feature type comparison saved")
}
```

## 9.5 Export Features for Future Analysis

Save the feature matrices for future use when more images are added.

``` {r export_features}
message("Exporting feature matrices...")

# Create features directory
features_dir <- file.path(PROG_DIR, "feature_matrices")
dir.create(features_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Save each feature type separately
for (feat_name in names(feature_data)) {
  feat_file <- file.path(features_dir, paste0(feat_name, "_features.rds"))
  saveRDS(feature_data[[feat_name]], feat_file)
  message(
    "  ✓ ", feat_name, ": ", nrow(feature_data[[feat_name]]), " images × ",
    ncol(feature_data[[feat_name]]), " features"
  )
}

# Also save combined matrix
combined_file <- file.path(features_dir, "all_features_combined.rds")
saveRDS(all_features, combined_file)

# Save feature differences (if 2 images)
if (exists("feature_diff")) {
  diff_csv <- file.path(features_dir, "feature_differences.csv")
  write.csv(feature_diff, diff_csv, row.names = FALSE)
  message("\n✓ Feature differences saved to: feature_differences.csv")
}

message("\n✓ All features exported to: ", basename(features_dir))
```
